jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: AI Infrastructure Engineer **Company:** Amaara Networks **Location:** Livermore, CA — Hybrid, with regular onsite work at our data center facility **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Experience Level:** 4–7 years **Travel:** Occasional travel, up to 10–15% **Reports To:** Manager, Data Center Operations About Amaara Networks Amaara Networks builds and operates the physical and systems infrastructure that supports modern AI workloads. Our teams deploy, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot high\-performance GPU clusters and the networking infrastructure that enables customers to train and run AI models. We are looking for an **AI Infrastructure Engineer** who enjoys working across hardware, Linux systems, high\-performance networking, and GPU infrastructure. This is a hands\-on engineering position with responsibility for complex Tier 2/Tier 3 escalations, deployments, troubleshooting, automation, and continuous improvement. Position Summary As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will support the full lifecycle of high\-performance GPU infrastructure—from physical installation and commissioning through Linux configuration, GPU validation, networking, troubleshooting, and production operations. You will be responsible for resolving complex infrastructure issues, identifying root causes, working directly with vendors and customers, and developing the documentation and automation that makes our infrastructure more reliable and scalable. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both **working in the data center and solving problems from the terminal**. Key ResponsibilitiesInfrastructure Troubleshooting \& Escalation * Own Tier 2 and Tier 3 infrastructure escalations from investigation through resolution. * Perform root\-cause analysis on server and infrastructure failures using BMC/IPMI logs, kernel messages, MCE/EDAC records, thermal and power telemetry, and vendor diagnostics. * Identify recurring hardware and infrastructure issues and develop permanent corrective actions. * Participate in post\-incident reviews and translate findings into monitoring improvements, runbooks, and operational standards. * Work directly with hardware vendors on diagnostics, RMAs, firmware issues, and field\-service activities. * Communicate clearly with customers during incidents and scheduled maintenance windows. * Coordinate remote hands and field technicians during work performed at remote sites. * Participate in an infrastructure on\-call rotation. GPU Infrastructure * Deploy, administer, and troubleshoot high\-performance GPU compute systems. * Support NVIDIA H100/H200/B200/B300 SXM and PCIe platforms, AMD Instinct, or comparable accelerator platforms. * Use tools such as **nvidia\-smi, DCGM, and DCGM diagnostics** to troubleshoot GPU health and performance issues. * Analyze XID errors, ECC events, NVLink/NVSwitch health, thermal conditions, and power\-related throttling. * Install and maintain GPU drivers, CUDA toolkits, Fabric Manager, and container runtimes. * Manage software and driver compatibility across the GPU fleet. * Perform GPU stress testing, burn\-in, NCCL testing, bandwidth testing, and all\-reduce benchmarking. * Investigate performance issues including straggler nodes, reduced collective bandwidth, PCIe degradation, NUMA configuration, and topology problems. High\-Performance Networking * Configure and support **InfiniBand and RoCEv2** high\-performance AI networking environments. * Configure switches, manage firmware, and validate network topology. * Support InfiniBand subnet management, partitioning, routing, and topology validation. * Use tools such as **UFM, OFED, ibdiagnet, ibnetdiscover, and perfquery** to troubleshoot network issues. * Diagnose link flaps, symbol errors, degraded optics, cabling issues, and port\-level failures. * Configure and troubleshoot RoCE environments, including PFC, ECN, lossless queues, and congestion control. * Administer RDMA/OFED stacks, NIC/HCA firmware, bonding, VLANs, and management networks. * Support enterprise networking, including L2/L3 networking, VLANs, LACP, MLAG/VLT, firewalls, NAT, VPN, DHCP, and DNS. * Validate network performance following deployments and infrastructure changes. * Maintain accurate network topology, port maps, and infrastructure documentation. Linux Systems Administration * Administer Linux systems including **RHEL, Rocky Linux, and Ubuntu**. * Manage provisioning, patching, kernels, drivers, storage, filesystems, networking, users, and access. * Operate bare\-metal provisioning platforms such as **MAAS, Foreman, Ironic, or similar technologies**. * Troubleshoot PXE, commissioning, enrollment, deployment, and image\-related issues. * Configure cloud\-init, netplan, bonded networking, and storage layouts. * Tune Linux hosts for GPU and HPC workloads, including NUMA, CPU pinning, IRQ affinity, and I/O configuration. * Monitor hosts, GPUs, networking, and environmental conditions. * Develop monitoring, dashboards, and alerts to identify issues before they  erational runbooks. Qualifications * **4–7 years of experience** combining data center operations, infrastructure engineering, and Linux systems administration. * Strong production Linux administration experience with RHEL, Rocky Linux, or Ubuntu. * Experience managing Linux kernels, drivers, storage, networking, and shell\-level diagnostics. * Hands\-on experience operating a bare\-metal provisioning platform. * Experience with PXE, node commissioning, deployment, and provisioning troubleshooting. * Experience using **Redfish and IPMI** for hardware management, power control, boot configuration, and firmware operations. * Demonstrated Tier 2/Tier 3 escalation and incident\-resolution experience. * Strong server hardware troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills. * Experience with BMC/IPMI logs, system event logs, and Linux kernel diagnostics. * Experience with high\-performance networking, including **InfiniBand, RoCE, or high\-speed Ethernet**. * Working knowledge of production L2/L3 networking. * Experience supporting GPU or accelerated\-computing systems. * Understanding of data center fundamentals including power, cooling, airflow, cabling, and rack layouts. * Scripting experience with **Python or Bash**. * Familiarity with configuration management tools such as **Ansible**. * Strong technical writing and documentation skills. * Ability to communicate directly with customers during infrastructure incidents. * Ability to coordinate remote technicians and field\-service personnel. * Willingness to participate in an on\-call rotation and occasional after\-hours maintenance windows. Preferred Qualifications * Experience supporting large\-scale, multi\-rack GPU clusters. * Experience with NVIDIA SXM systems, NVLink/NVSwitch, or rail\-optimized network architectures. * Deep InfiniBand experience, including UFM, subnet management, ibdiagnet, adaptive routing, or SHARP. * Experience with Slurm, Kubernetes GPU Operators, Run:ai, or similar workload schedulers. * Experience with high\-performance storage such as Lustre, GPFS, WEKA, VAST, or NFS over RDMA. * Experience with liquid\-cooled or high\-density data center infrastructure. * Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM Exporter, Elasticsearch, or similar observability platforms. * RHCSA, RHCE, NVIDIA networking/InfiniBand certifications, CompTIA Server\+/Network\+, or Uptime Institute certifications. * Experience working in a growth\-stage environment where processes and standards are being developed. Working Conditions \& Physical Requirements This position includes regular work inside an operating data center. Candidates must be able to, with or without reasonable accommodation: * Lift and maneuver equipment weighing up to 50 lbs. unassisted and heavier equipment with team or lift assistance. * Work on ladders and in confined areas, including under raised floors and in overhead cable trays. * Stand, walk, kneel, and reach for extended periods. * Work in environments with sustained equipment noise, cold aisles, and limited natural light. * Wear required personal protective equipment (PPE). * Follow all electrical, data center, and site safety procedures. Compensation \& Benefits * **Compensation:** Negotiable, depending on experience * 401(k) * Healthcare reimbursement * Paid holidays * Flexible time off / flex\-time Why Join Amaara Networks? This is an opportunity to work directly with the infrastructure powering modern AI workloads. You'll have the opportunity to work across **GPU systems, Linux, high\-performance networking, automation, hardware, and data center operations** while helping build reliable infrastructure at scale. If you enjoy solving difficult infrastructure problems, working hands\-on with cutting\-edge technology, and turning recurring problems into permanent solutions, we'd like to hear from you. **Apply today to join Amaara Networks as an AI Infrastructure Engineer.** Pay: $1\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Paid time off Work Location: In person

jobs.title: AI Software Engineer | LLMs, RAG & Private AI - Interview Today - Start Tomorrow
jobs.description: **Job details** * **Company:** MemeHouse, LA * **Location:** Beverly Hills, CA In Person and Remote * **Employment type:** Full\-time, Part\-Time, W\-2 employee, or Contract * **Annual base salary:** $130,000–$180,00 * **Additional compensation:** $5,000 performance\-based signing incentive, earned through two initial\-delivery milestones targeted for the first 90 days **About us** At MemeHouse LA, we build AI software that helps businesses turn their information into useful decisions and reliable workflows. Our focus is practical: secure AI deployments, connected business systems, and applications that deliver measurable value. We are looking for an engineer who wants to build more than demonstrations. You will help create dependable AI capabilities, from model selection and data integration through deployment, evaluation, security, and ongoing improvement. **About the role** As an AI Software Engineer, you will design, build, and deploy AI\-powered applications using large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, and modern software engineering practices. You will work across the application and infrastructure stack, helping translate business requirements into systems that users can trust. This is a hands\-on role with ownership of meaningful technical deliverables. You will collaborate with product and business stakeholders, explain technical trade\-offs, and help establish repeatable practices as the team grows. **What you will do** * **Build AI applications:** Develop production\-oriented LLM features, retrieval systems, workflow automations, and APIs that address defined business needs. * **Deploy private models:** Evaluate and serve appropriately licensed open\-weight models on private, dedicated, or customer\-controlled infrastructure. * **Connect business data:** Integrate approved documents, databases, CRMs, business applications, and other structured or unstructured data sources. * **Engineer reliable retrieval:** Build ingestion, indexing, embedding, retrieval, and citation workflows with appropriate access controls. * **Evaluate quality:** Create repeatable tests for response quality, groundedness, latency, cost, and failure modes; use results to guide improvements. * **Operate dependable systems:** Implement deployment pipelines, observability, error handling, versioning, rollback procedures, and operational documentation. * **Protect sensitive information:** Apply least\-privilege access, secrets management, tenant separation where applicable, and safeguards against prompt injection and unintended data disclosure. * **Improve the engineering function:** Participate in code reviews, document architectural decisions, share findings, and help mentor additional engineers as the team expands. **What we are looking for** * **Software engineering ability:** Strong Python skills and demonstrated experience building maintainable software, APIs, automated tests, and data integrations. * **Applied AI experience:** Hands\-on work with LLM applications, embeddings, RAG, model evaluation, or fine\-tuning when appropriate. * **Relevant tooling:** Experience with tools such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM, LangChain, or LlamaIndex. We value sound engineering judgment over familiarity with every listed tool. * **Backend and deployment fundamentals:** Comfort with SQL, Git, Linux, Docker, API authentication, and CI/CD workflows. * **Data engineering knowledge:** Experience processing business data and designing reliable ingestion or transformation pipelines. * **Security awareness:** Ability to reason about data privacy, permissions, model limitations, and secure deployment. * **Ownership and communication:** Ability to scope work, communicate blockers early, document decisions, and deliver usable results. * **Demonstrated capability:** Relevant professional experience, substantial project work, or equivalent evidence of technical proficiency. A specific degree is not required. **Helpful additional experience** * **GPU and inference optimization:** CUDA, quantization, batching, GPU memory management, or inference benchmarking. * **Infrastructure:** Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, private networking, or on\-premises deployments. * **Business integrations:** CRM, ERP, finance, document\-management, or analytics platforms. * **Advanced evaluation:** Permission\-aware retrieval testing, adversarial testing, or production AI observability. * **Team contribution:** Open\-source work, technical writing, or mentoring other engineers. **Your first 90 days** * **First 30 days:** Understand the architecture, security requirements, and priority use case; establish the development environment and evaluation approach. * **Target by day 45:** Deliver a working AI prototype connected to an approved data source, with reproducible setup instructions and initial evaluation results. * **Target by day 90:** Deliver a production\-ready version of the agreed feature in an approved staging or production environment, supported by automated tests, monitoring, and a deployment and rollback runbook. **Compensation and $5,000 signing incentive** The annual base salary range is $130,000–$180,000\. The starting offer will reflect the responsibilities of the position, demonstrated skills, relevant experience, and internal pay equity; the $5,000 incentive is separate from base salary. We offer a **$5,000 gross performance\-based signing incentive**, structured as a new\-hire milestone bonus rather than an upfront payment: * **Milestone one: $2,500\.** Earned upon completion of the agreed prototype, data integration, and initial evaluation deliverables, targeted for day 45\. * **Milestone two: $2,500\.** Earned upon completion of the agreed production\-readiness, testing, monitoring, and documentation deliverables, targeted for day 90\. Written milestone requirements and objective acceptance criteria will be provided before employment begins. Each installment is earned when its criteria are satisfied and will be paid on the next regular payday, or earlier if required by applicable law, less required tax withholdings. The 45\- and 90\-day dates are delivery targets, not minimum\-service or automatic\-forfeiture dates. Once earned, an installment is not conditioned on continued employment through its payment date and does not have to be repaid if employment later ends. **Benefits** * **Health coverage:** Employer\-sponsored health insurance, subject to plan eligibility and terms. * **Retirement benefits:** 401(k) participation, subject to plan eligibility and terms. * **Time off:** Unlimited paid time off under the company’s written policy, plus applicable paid sick leave and other legally protected leave. **Why join us?** You will have direct ownership of useful AI capabilities and the opportunity to shape how they are built and operated. We value clear thinking, candid communication, responsible handling of customer information, and engineering that holds up beyond the demo. **Equal opportunity and accommodations** MemeHouse LA is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without discrimination based on any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law and provide reasonable accommodations during the application process and employment. **How to apply** Submit your resume and, if available, a GitHub profile, portfolio, or short description of a relevant AI project to us. Please do not submit confidential information belonging to a current or former employer or client.

jobs.title: Construction Project Manager
jobs.description: **Position summary** -------------------- Brookwood Group is seeking a contract Project Manager to lead cost estimating and pre\-construction support on a federal construction program in Liberty County, GA. The Project Manager owns the estimate: building it, defending it, keeping it current through design, and putting credible options in front of the client when the number comes in over target. The Project Manager does not hold construction risk and does not act for the contractor. **Program\-specific responsibilities** -------------------------------------- * Build and maintain the project cost estimate across all design phases, working alongside the Project Engineer. * Produce and submit native estimate files and quantity takeoffs with each design submittal, in the formats the client requires. * Keep the cost trend log current between milestones, logging each scope change, design development item, and market movement as it occurs rather than reconstructing it at the next submittal. * Represent Brookwood at the three open\-book reconciliation meetings, presenting and defending line\-item positions against the contractor's estimate and driving each variance to resolution. * When an estimate exceeds the target price, develop and price options that close the gap: scope adjustments, alternates, value engineering, phasing, and schedule\-driven cost strategies, each with the tradeoff stated plainly. * Support the client on agreement schedules due, including the cost and quantity backup those schedules depend on. **General project responsibilities** ------------------------------------ * Serve as the client's day\-to\-day point of contact on cost, and speak for Brookwood in meetings with the design team, contractor, and agency stakeholders. * Review design documents at each milestone for constructability, completeness, and cost impact, and raise issues while they are still inexpensive to fix. * Reconcile independent estimates against contractor and design\-team estimates, isolate the drivers behind each variance, and document the basis of the agreed number. * Maintain the basis of estimate: assumptions, exclusions, allowances, escalation, contingency, and market conditions, so any figure can be traced to its source months later. * Monitor schedule against cost, and flag where sequence, procurement lead times, or phasing are moving the number. * Review change proposals and contractor pricing for reasonableness, and recommend a position to the owner. * Report cost status to the client at an executive level: where the project stands against target, what changed since last report, what is at risk, and what decision is needed. * Direct the Project Engineer's work, review their takeoffs and quantities, and hold the quality standard on everything leaving the team. * Keep project records complete and auditable, consistent with federal documentation expectations. **Required qualifications** --------------------------- * **Federal government construction experience is required.** Demonstrated work on projects for a federal agency or federally funded construction program, with working knowledge of federal procurement, documentation, and reporting expectations. * 5\-8\+ years in construction project management, cost estimating, or preconstruction on vertical building construction. * Demonstrated ownership of a project estimate from early design through award, including defending it in reconciliation. * Fluency in a recognized estimating platform and in digital takeoff tools, with the ability to deliver native files rather than PDFs alone. * Command of CSI MasterFormat or UNIFORMAT cost structures and the ability to move between them. * Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, architecture, quantity surveying, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * Eligible for any badging, background check, or facility access the client requires. Preferred qualifications * Prior work as an owner's representative, program manager, or construction manager as agent, rather than on the contractor side. * Experience with USACE, NAVFAC, GSA, VA, or similar agency processes and submittal standards. * CCP, CPE, PMP, CCM, or equivalent credential. * Experience running open\-book reconciliation with a CM\-at\-Risk or design\-build contractor. * Familiarity with the Savannah and coastal Georgia construction market, including local subcontractor capacity and pricing conditions.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Turbo AI turns anything you upload into bite\-sized lessons that make learning fast and actually fun. 12 million users in less than 2 years. * $170k to $260k cash \+ competitive equity * Lunch and dinner in the office every day * Unlimited PTO **Turbo Engineering?** You ship a feature in the morning and watch tens of thousands of people use it that afternoon. No PMs, no spec handoffs, no quarterly planning cycle. Engineers own features end\-to\-end: from identifying the problem \-\> brainstorming solutions \-\> implementing it \-\> monitoring user analytics \-\> decide what iterations to make \- you're not just a code monkey. That combination is rare. Most places give you scale with no ownership, or ownership with nobody using the thing. Here you get a small team, real surface area each, and a million people a month on the other end of it. We're highly profitable and growing. Most of this job is judgment and communication. In a world where coding is faster than ever with smarter LLMs everyday, deciding what to build and what to skip, then telling everyone clearly what you're doing and why is the priority. If you can look at a business problem, work out which part actually matters this week, and explain that in a few sentences, you'll do very well here. We continuously optimize for solutions that take 20% of the time for 80% of the value before sinking precious engineering resources into areas. If it can be done in 200 lines with tools we already have, that's the right answer, even if it isn't elegant and even if it needs redoing in three months. Shipping something 80% right today beats something perfect next month. This is the thing we care about most. If your instinct is to build the framework instead of the script, or to handle every edge case before shipping, you'll find this frustrating. * Modern React on web * React Native on mobile * Python and TypeScript servers on the backend * PostgresSQL ' * You've shipped real things that real people used * You default to the simplest solution and can explain why the complicated one isn't worth it * You think about the business, not just the ticket. You can tell which work actually moves the number. * Clear, direct communicator. You write things down and people understand them the first time. * Genuinely fluent with AI coding tools. This isn't a bonus, it's how the whole team works. * Comfortable owning something without being managed New York, in person. Everyone here is young, ambitious and moves fast.

jobs.title: Full Stack Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** Octavian Robotics is solving the \#1 complication in the $3T surgical industry. We are building robots for the sterilization of surgical tools. Only now with generalized robotics models have we been able to tackle this problem and save lives. This company is a spin\-out from Sorting Robotics and we are inheriting a decade of robotics infrastructure and know\-how. **The role is for the first robotics software engineer at the company.** You'll be working directly with the founders and learning from the previous team on how to build a robotics company. You'll need to be scrappy, a jack of all trades and a master of one, be able to communicate your ideas quickly and effectively, adapt to changing dynamics, have experience with robotics, and be able to push through the journey of building a new company. This role is not for the faint of heart. You should expect to work 60\+ hours a week, expect for there to be more problems than solutions, expect for you to have very little hand\-holding, invent technology that didn't exist 6 months ago, expect to feel the pressure of performance when everyone in the room is depending on you and there are millions of dollars on the line. All this will be true, but you will also be in a room of people that respect you; where everyone is rowing together to achieve the noble goal of saving lives with our robotic systems. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and implement software to control machines developed by Octavian Robotics. * Build and implement the initial infrastructure of the company. * Work closely with mechanical and electrical engineers and guide design decisions based on what software can effectively accomplish. * Work closely with customer success and sales staff to translate customer and company needs into software solutions. * Train entry/mid\-level software developers in the development lifecycle of the product lines you're working on. * Work with engineers and customer success staff to remote and debug logs in the machine and understand customer problems. * This is an on\-site position. You're expected to work on\-site with the other team members five days a week. We are based in Los Angeles. Sometimes, nothing will work, and you'll need to conduct experiments until the problem's root cause (hardware or software\-related) is fully understood. Before writing any code, you must deeply understand complex topics and communicate proposed solutions to a highly technical team. Ideally, you write the minimum number of lines that solve the problem ("spin lock? Why not? It solves this problem" \- "I'll just use a JSON file for now as a database so anyone can easily modify it"). Your work will be focused more on clear communication and business impact than on lines of code you can write or cool tech you can use. **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with Python * Familiarity with Git * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, AWS services * Familiarity with web standards, RESTful APIs, OAuth You will work on different parts of the stack at various times. We expect you to understand where everything goes and why, and we expect you to add to the stack to make the development process more robust. **Requirements** * Must be AI\-Native in all workflows * Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields. * Experience with Linux (systemd, journalctl, network manager, permissions). * Experience in training VLA or inference models for motor control * Experience working with Hardware. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Strong communication and collaboration skills. **Benefits** * $170,000 \- $190,000 per year full\-time salary. * 401(k), health, dental and vision insurance, flexible spending account, paid time off, parental leave. * Schedule: 12\-hour shift, Monday \- Saturday. This job is not for the weak of heart. * In person, Van Nuys or Los Angeles, CA. Relocation package available.

jobs.title: ML Engineer
jobs.description: Astrocade is an AI technology company building super\-intelligence for the interactive world, delivered through a breakout consumer platform. Today's frontier models can write, reason, and generate video. None can build a world you can step into and act on. Interactive world models are one of the defining problems on the path to ASI, and the foundation of the next great consumer platform. Interactivity is the holy grail of content: not something you watch, but something that responds to you. We're further ahead than anyone: the only team building the intelligence and the platform together, and both are already live. Our social UGC platform lets anyone create and play interactive experiences through natural language. And it's one of the fastest\-growing consumer products in the world, with over 30 million users in just months since launch. Creators bring to life games, companions that remember and grow with them, learning experiences that adapt like a great tutor, and social worlds built with friends. The platform also powers our research with data no video dataset contains: millions of creators prompting and refining gives us paired data of human intent and the worlds that fulfill it, and every play session produces ground\-truth, action\-labeled interaction data at scale. All of it flows back into our models, and research ships to real players in days, spinning a flywheel no one else can build. We are a small team from Google Research, Meta, FAIR, Character.ai, and Stanford, led alongside Fei\-Fei Li, with frontier\-scale compute and direct ownership of core model problems. We are backed by Sequoia Capital, Google, NVIDIA, and luminaries including Eric Schmidt and Jerry Yang. The next foundational AI company will be built where world models meet a billion players. We're the rare place where frontier research and a breakout consumer platform are one company, and where your work ships to millions, not to a paper. Come build it with us. **About the Role** Every experience on Astrocade starts as an idea from a creator. An agentic AI system turns that idea into something playable. How good that experience turns out to be is our north\-star metric. Your job is to move that metric. As an ML Engineer on our AI team, you'll own how our creation system behaves, where it fails, and how it gets better. You'll dig into real creator sessions to find where generation breaks down, build the evals that tell us whether a change actually helped, and design the agentic systems behind the next version of creation on the platform. This is applied ML with a direct line to product. What you ship shows up in the games millions of players see. We're a small team of about 20 engineers, and nobody here stays in a lane. You'll work across models, agents, data pipelines, and infrastructure as the problem requires, and you'll collaborate directly with our CTO and co\-founders. **What You'll Do** * Own the quality of AI\-generated content end to end, including model behavior, agent orchestration, prompting, tool use, and the failure modes in between * Build evaluation and insight systems on production creator data that measure failure rates, quality, and where the system is strong or weak, and turn those findings into concrete improvements * Design and build agentic ML systems that take a creator's idea and reliably produce a great, playable game * Debug hard problems across the stack, from a bad generation down to the data, the model, or the pipeline that caused it * Run experiments quickly, measure rigorously, and ship what works * Help define how the AI team works as it grows, including tooling, eval standards, and technical direction **You'd Be a Great Fit If You:** * Have 3–7\+ years of experience in ML engineering or applied ML, with a track record of shipping models or AI systems to real users * Have built LLM\-powered or agentic systems in productionTreat evals as a core part of the job: you've designed metrics and eval sets and know when a number is lying to you * Have strong CS fundamentals and write clean, efficient code (Python\-heavy) * Reason well about probability and statistics, and are comfortable being tested on it * Are a builder with high agency and a bias for action, and want to own outcomes rather than tickets * Have played with Astrocade and have opinions about what the content should be **Bonus Points** * Background in code generation, program synthesis, or LLM\-for\-code * Experience at a fast\-moving AI startup, or on applied ML teams at large consumer companies * Interest in games, UGC, or creator platforms * Exposure to post\-training or fine\-tuning, and a sense of when it beats better prompting and orchestration **What we Offer** ================= * Competitive salary, meaningful equity, and performance bonus. * 100% employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees and eligible dependents. * Flexible PTO and unlimited sick time. * **$650/month AI Tools budget** to use on the tools that help you do your best work. * **$500/month Lifestyle Benefit** for wellness, fitness, meals, house cleaning, and more. * **$200/month Fun Benefit** to spend on hobbies, travel, games, concerts, or whatever brings you joy. * Up to **16 weeks paid parental leave** for birth parents and **12 weeks** for non\-birth parents, plus a **$1,500/month childcare benefit**. * **$2,000 workspace setup allowance** and **$200/month commuter benefit**. * Daily breakfast, lunch, and dinner on in\-office days, plus regular team events and offsites. * 401(k) retirement plan through Human Interest. Join us to help build the future of interactive entertainment! Compensation Range: $200K \- $250K

jobs.title: Mechatronics Engineer (Lead)
jobs.description: **Overview** Octavian Robotics is solving the \#1 complication in the $3T surgical industry. We are building robots for the sterilization of surgical tools. Only now with generalized robotics models have we been able to tackle this problem and save lives. This company is a spin\-out from Sorting Robotics and we are inheriting a decade of robotics infrastructure and know\-how. We are hiring the Cognizant Engineer (CogE) to own our flagship: a VLA\-powered (Vision\-Language\-Action) gripping and manipulation system for surgical instruments. You will lead this product from the rig on the bench to machines running inside hospital Sterile Processing Departments, and you will own its technical success end to end. This is a hands\-on technical leadership seat. You will design the end\-effector and mechatronics, integrate vision and force and tactile sensing into a 6DOF arm, and operationalize learned manipulation policies (VLA models) so the system reliably grips, sorts, and handles surgical instruments in the real world. You work directly with the founders. Expect to learn a lot fast, hit days where nothing works, and ship a product that saves lives in a room full of people who appreciate you. **What you will own** * Own the VLA gripping and manipulation system cradle to grave: concept, design, build, bring\-up, deployment, and field reliability. You are accountable for its technical success. * Design the gripper and mechatronics: end\-effector design, actuation, GD\&T drawings, mass, cost and manufacturability tradeoffs, rapid prototyping (3D print, laser, CNC, PCB), and production\-ready designs. * Integrate perception and sensing into the manipulation loop: cameras and vision, force, torque and tactile feedback, and the 6DOF arm. * Operationalize VLA and learned manipulation policies: stand up the data pipeline (teleop and demonstration collection), wire policy inference into real\-time control, evaluate grasp and handling success, and close the sim\-to\-real and on\-robot iteration loop. * Optimize with modeling and test: analytical and physical simulation, then validate on hardware. * Interface with suppliers to build supply chain and vendor qualification for manufacturing feasibility, validation, and assigned commodities; deliver world\-class fit, finish, and craftsmanship for launch. * Support deployment: help assemble and install systems at hospital sites as needed. Travel is approximately 1 to 5 percent. **Ideal candidate skills** * B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or Robotics (M.S. a plus). * Real experience taking a robotic system from concept to delivery on an R\&D team. * Manipulation and gripping experience: end\-effector or gripper design, grasping, pick\-and\-place, or assembly automation. * 6DOF and cobot arm integration, including low\-level programming and motion control. * Comfortable at the hardware and ML boundary: you do not have to train VLA models from scratch, but you can integrate learned policies, run inference on a robot, collect and curate demonstration data, and debug why a policy fails on real hardware. Familiarity with modern manipulation stacks (ROS or ROS 2, OpenVLA or pi\-0 style policies, RT\-style models, imitation learning, sim\-to\-real) is a strong plus. * Strong Python; working knowledge of real\-time or embedded control. * Fluent with prototyping tools: CAD, 3D printing, laser cutter, CNC, PCB. * Takes initiative across whatever the company needs to win. Able to work extended hours and weekends as needed. **Requirements** * B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, or similar. * Strong understanding of AI tools. We're looking for an "AI native" engineer. * Technical depth in robotics, automation, or a related field; has shipped from concept to delivery. * Demonstrated work on 6DOF or similar cobot arms. * Working knowledge of Python or a similar language. * Minimum 10 years of full\-time on the job experience. * Bonus: hands\-on with manipulation or grasping, or with learned policies (VLA, imitation learning, ROS). * Not currently enrolled in a college or graduate program. * Free to work without visa sponsorship. * On\-site in Van Nuys or Los Angeles (reliable commute or willing to relocate). Some travel to hospital sites will be required. **Benefits** * $170,000 \- $190,000 per year full\-time salary. * 401(k), health, dental and vision insurance, flexible spending account, paid time off, parental leave. * Schedule: 12\-hour shift, Monday \- Saturday. This job is not for the weak of heart. * In person, Van Nuys or Los Angeles, CA. Relocation package available.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **About Sonari** Sonari is a well\-funded startup and the world's first company to deploy AI\-powered ultrasound in professional sports, converting a fast, portable scan into objective data on an athlete's tissue health, performance and endurance over time. We're working toward an unprecedented goal: predicting soft\-tissue and non\-contact injuries. Our technology is grounded in peer\-reviewed research. We're backed by a global investment firm ($70B\+ AUM), and we're already in partnership with a Major League Baseball team and a Premier League club. Our aim is to put this capability in the hands of every sports organization in the world, from championship rosters to the academies where the next generation is coming up. We're mission\-driven and looking for like\-minded top engineers who want to build at the intersection of AI, medical imaging and sports. **The role** You own the **platform end to end** — the backend API and data model *and* the web frontend that clinicians and team staff use. The platform is the hub: it authenticates devices and users, ingests the ultrasound the tablet app uploads, stores it in a multi\-tenant, de\-identified data store, dispatches analysis jobs, and gives clinicians and team staff a web application to review images, add annotations, and track athlete metrics over time. If the app is the point of capture and the models are the intelligence, the platform is where it all lands and becomes useful. Much of the stack is still being decided, so you'll help choose it. You'll work in a fast\-paced, hands\-on environment, reporting directly to the CTO. *Stack note*: we've settled on Django / Django REST Framework for the backend. Most other choices — cloud provider, database, frontend framework, auth provider, image viewer — are not locked in. The role is described tech\-agnostically on purpose; strong opinions and the willingness to help make these calls are a plus.What you'll work onBackend * **Greenfield backend in Django \+ DRF** (our chosen framework), backed by a **relational database** and **cloud object storage**. A batteries\-included stack for a multi\-tenant athlete\-data app: ORM, migrations, admin, auth. * **Multi\-tenancy with strict isolation.** Tenant (org/team) is part of every key. Enforce isolation defense\-in\-depth: **row\-level isolation** *and* service\-layer ownership checks. Strict cross\-team isolation is a top requirement. * **Ingest.** Implement the device upload contract — an upload\-intent step that mints presigned upload URLs and a complete step that verifies the objects landed — including clip and sampling\-stream routing. * **Auth.** Validate tokens from a **managed auth provider** (whichever we adopt — the provider may change over time) in the backend, for both web users (team / clinician / admin roles, invite\-only, MFA for sensitive data) and the device upload path. * **The annotation \& analysis layer.** Persist the platform's canonical **annotation / measurement / report** records; expose the read API for the frontend; dispatch **analysis jobs** to the ML services and ingest their results (metrics \+ annotation overlays); fire **"new images/results"** alerts to staff (event\-driven). * **Privacy\-ready seams from day one.** A separate identifier store keyed server\-side, a single audit chokepoint, org\-keying everywhere, encryption/TLS throughout — built now so turning on stricter privacy controls later is configuration and paperwork, not a rewrite. Export de\-identified images \+ labels to the model factory. **Frontend** * **Build the web frontend from the ground up.** The framework and layout are still open — it may be a single\-page app or a multi\-page app — so you'll help decide the front\-end architecture and information design, not just implement a fixed spec: roster and player management, player profiles, **longitudinal analytics and trend charts**, and a **Team Command Center** dashboard. * **Front\-end UX/UI.** The layout and look\-and\-feel are greenfield; you'll shape them (with design input) so clinicians and team staff can move quickly through review and reporting. * **Embed a web\-based medical image viewer** (e.g. OHIF / Cornerstone3D, or another) for reviewing ultrasound and adding annotations and measurements, with **DICOM interop** (DICOMweb, PNG↔DICOM conversion). * Org\-admin and super\-admin provisioning/settings UIs. **Required skills** * Strong **Python** and **Django \+ Django REST Framework** (models, migrations, DRF serializers/views, auth). * **Relational database** depth (e.g. PostgreSQL): schema design, query performance, and ideally row\-level isolation and JSONB/array usage for a multi\-tenant app. * A **modern web frontend framework** (React, Vue, Svelte, or similar) with **TypeScript** — building real data\-dense UIs (tables, forms, dashboards, charts), plus the judgment to shape UX where the design is greenfield. * **Cloud infrastructure** on a major provider: object storage, a managed database, a managed auth provider, secrets management; comfort owning your own infrastructure early. * **Contract\-driven development**: building against **OpenAPI / JSON\-Schema** definitions and generated types, with additive\-only, versioned API discipline. * A **security mindset**: multi\-tenant isolation, least privilege, auth token handling, and keeping identifying data out of logs and objects. * **AI\-assisted development** as a daily habit: you use tools like Claude Code, Codex or Cursor to move faster, and you have the judgment to know when their output is right and when it isn't. **Nice to have** * **DICOM / PACS / medical imaging** on the web — e.g. OHIF, Cornerstone3D, DICOMweb, DICOM SR/SEG. * **Infrastructure\-as\-code** and CI/CD (this role initially stretches to cover DevOps; a dedicated DevOps hire is planned). * Experience handling **sensitive health data** and awareness of privacy/regulatory architecture (audit logging, field encryption) — depth is a plus; we retain regulatory specialists separately. * Event\-driven / queue\-based backends (job dispatch, alerting). * Data visualization for longitudinal / time\-series metrics, and general product/UX sensibility. **Tech stack you'll touch** Python · **Django \+ DRF** (chosen) · a relational database (e.g. PostgreSQL) · a major cloud provider (object storage, managed DB, managed auth, secrets) · a modern web frontend framework \+ TypeScript · OpenAPI / JSON\-Schema contracts · a web\-based medical image viewer (e.g. OHIF / Cornerstone3D) \+ DICOMweb · presigned\-upload API · event\-driven alerting. *(Backend framework aside, most of this is still open.)* How this role fits the team You'll be one of the first members of our engineering team, and the platform is the connective tissue between the other two roles. You consume the **iOS Engineer's** uploads and define the API they build against; you dispatch jobs to and display results from the **Machine Learning Engineer's** analysis services, and feed their model factory with labeled, de\-identified data. Every seam is a shared, versioned contract, so the parts of the system move independently without breaking each other. Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $200,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Cambridge, MA 02142

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Linux Systems & Application Observability

be based on the candidate's level of experience and qualifications.* **Discretionary Performance Bonus:** 15\-20% of base salary based on individual and company performance. **About IGNA \+ tasty** IG North America is home to tastytrade, tasty*live \&* tastyfx—a family of brands built to democratize trading and empower individual investors. Founded in Chicago by the creators of thinkorswim, acquired by London\-based IG Group in 2021, we combine startup innovation with the backing of a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents serving over 1\.3m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. From our headquarters in Chicago's Fulton Market, our team builds award\-winning trading platforms, produces live financial education content daily, and creates technology that makes complex markets accessible. tastytrade is our retail brokerage for self\-directed investing and trading, with tasty*live* providing content to educate our customers. tastyfx is the fastest\-growing forex broker in the US. tastycrypto provides self\-custody digital wallets for decentralized finance. We're a lean, collaborative team that values autonomy, pragmatism, and impact. Join us at IG\|tasty – the future gets built here. **Location:** Our office is in the West Loop \- Chicago's growing center of tech, great cuisine, and high\-end bars. **tastytrade** **\|** **tasty*****live*** **\|** **tastyfx** 1330 W Fulton Market, Chicago, IL 60607 * Don't meet every single requirement? jobs.description: **About Sonari** Sonari is a well\-funded startup and the world's first company to deploy AI\-powered ultrasound in professional sports, converting a fast, portable scan into objective data on an athlete's tissue health, performance and endurance over time. We're working toward an unprecedented goal: predicting soft\-tissue and non\-contact injuries. Our technology is grounded in peer\-reviewed research. We're backed by a global investment firm ($70B\+ AUM) and partnered with a Major League Baseball team and a Premier League club. Our aim is to put this capability in the hands of every sports organization worldwide, from championship rosters to academies where the next generation is emerging.We're mission\-driven and looking for like\-minded top engineers who want to build at the intersection of AI, medical imaging and sports. **The role** You own the **iPad app**: the capture experience and UX, the real\-time imaging pipeline from a handheld ultrasound probe, on\-device ML inference, and the secure, de\-identified upload path to the backend. The app is the point of capture and the edge of the whole system — everything downstream starts with the images it captures. You'll work in a fast\-paced, hands\-on environment, reporting directly to the CTO. **What you'll work on** * **A native iPad app** (Swift / SwiftUI, iOS 17\+) with a clean, testable separation between UI, imaging, and services. We lean on modern Swift Concurrency; the exact architecture is yours to shape. * **Capture UX \& UI.** Design and build the real\-time capture experience — navigation/guidance overlays, quality prompts, and capture confirmation — in close collaboration with design and the clinical team. Good UX is what lets a non\-expert user capture a good image, so this is core to the role, not an afterthought. * **Live ultrasound imaging** from a **handheld ultrasound probe** via its vendor imaging SDK \- typically BLE discovery → joining the probe's Wi\-Fi → streaming B\-mode imaging. The imaging boundary sits behind a protocol so the app develops and tests in the simulator against a **mock imaging source**, with the device\-only vendor framework isolated behind a single adapter. * **On\-device ML.** Run on\-device (e.g. CoreML) navigation and segmentation models to recognize views, score image quality, and drive the guidance overlays in real time. * **Two capture streams.** A user\-confirmed **diagnostic** stream and a consent\-gated background **sampling** stream for model improvement — each handled appropriately. * **Secure upload to the cloud.** Upload captured data to the cloud securely and reliably, ensuring it stays **de\-identified** — no athlete\-identifying information (name, DOB, operator, comments) ever leaves the device in image metadata, keys, filenames, logs, or crash reports; images carry only UUIDs and a numeric research ID. * **Secure device auth**, with tokens held in the Keychain. **Required skills** * Strong **Swift** and **SwiftUI**, with real experience shipping iPad/iOS apps — including a good sense for **UX/UI** on touch devices. * **Swift Concurrency**: async/await, actors, structured concurrency — you can reason about a real\-time streaming pipeline without data races. * A **testable, decoupled architecture**; comfort developing against mocks and abstractions rather than requiring hardware to make progress. * **On\-device ML** integration (e.g. CoreML): loading models, running them on image frames, and handling outputs for overlays. * Networking against **REST APIs** (secure uploads, token auth) and **Swift Package Manager** for dependency and shared\-contract consumption. * Testing with **XCTest**; a habit of keeping simulator builds green. * **AI\-assisted development** as a daily habit: you use tools like Claude Code, Codex or Cursor to move faster, and you have the judgment to know when their output is right and when it isn't. **Nice to have** * **Hardware / peripheral SDK** integration — **BLE / CoreBluetooth**, Wi\-Fi peripheral joining, or streaming\-media pipelines. * Prior work with **ultrasound, medical devices, or imaging** apps. * Strong visual/interaction **design** instincts, or experience partnering closely with designers. * **XcodeGen** or other project\-generation / reproducible\-project tooling. * Experience with de\-identified / regulated data handling on device (Keychain, excluding data from backups, no\-identifier logging). * Metal / Accelerate or performance tuning for real\-time image display. **Tech stack you'll touch** Swift · SwiftUI · Swift Concurrency · on\-device ML (CoreML) · a handheld\-ultrasound\-probe SDK (device\-only) · BLE \+ Wi\-Fi networking · **Swift Package Manager** · **XcodeGen** · XCTest · secure cloud uploads · a shared Swift\-package contract library generated from the platform's API/schema definitions. How this role fits the team You'll be one of the first members of our engineering team. The **Machine Learning Engineer** trains and packages the on\-device models you run; the **Full\-stack Engineer** operates the backend your uploads land in. The seams between you \- the imaging\-source protocol, the frame/metadata types, and the upload API \- are defined as shared, versioned contracts so the parts of the system can evolve independently. Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $180,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Cambridge, MA 02142

jobs.title: Software Developer 2
jobs.description: The Software Developer 2 is a fully qualified IT professional responsible for designing, developing, testing, implementing, and maintaining software applications and systems. This position works in a highly agile environment and may support multiple applications simultaneously while maintaining the Laboratory's security requirements and development standards. The Software Developer 2 applies established software development principles and specialized technical knowledge to resolve a variety of complex problems and develop effective solutions. The position works with limited direction, exercises independent judgment in selecting development methods and techniques, and plans and manages assigned activities to accomplish project objectives. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with **Java and the Spring Framework**, along with knowledge of **Angular** and **MySQL**. The position requires a commitment to quality software development practices, including **test\-driven development (TDD)**. **Flexible to be 100% onsite; or remote with onsite travel when needed.** * Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field** and a minimum of **five (5\) years of related experience**, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Strong professional experience developing software applications using **Java**. * Strong experience with the **Spring Framework**. * Experience developing and maintaining enterprise or web\-based applications. * Experience with **Angular** or similar modern web application frameworks. * Experience with **MySQL** and relational database development. * Experience with software development methodologies, processes, and best practices. * Experience with **test\-driven development (TDD)** and software testing practices. * Ability to analyze complex technical problems and develop effective software solutions. * Ability to work effectively in a highly agile environment and manage multiple application development efforts or assignments. * Ability to work independently with limited direction and exercise sound judgment when determining approaches to technical problems. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, organizational, and problem\-solving skills. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work collaboratively with developers, customers, technical teams, and other stakeholders. * Ability to understand and comply with Laboratory information technology, cybersecurity, and security requirements.

jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description: Software Engineer I : **APPLY at**: **https://virnous.com/careers/** Department: Engineering Reports to: Director of Engineering / Chief Technology Officer Employment type: Full\-time Level: Entry level (1 to 3 years of experience) Position Summary Virnous builds software for the people who work criminal cases: detectives, crime analysts, and prosecutors. Our main product, CANDOR, takes the raw data that shows up in a modern investigation, such as phone carrier records, cell site location information (CSLI), device extractions, and social media returns, and turns it into maps, timelines, and reports that an investigator can use and defend in court. We also build a public tip line, a training platform, and CANDOR Edge, a self\-contained version of CANDOR for agencies whose data can’t leave their building. As a Software Engineer I, you’ll be working on real features and bug fixes from your first few weeks. Most of our code is Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, with a good amount of JavaScript on the front end. You’ll get code review, pairing, and plenty of room to ask questions. In return, we need you to be careful. The files our customers upload are evidence, and what our software shows them can end up in front of a jury. Getting it right matters more to us than getting it done fast. Key Duties \& Responsibilities Build and maintain features across CANDOR and our other Rails applications, from the database migration through the view, along with the tests that cover them. Write and improve the importers that read what investigators bring us: carrier call detail records, tower lists, spreadsheets, PDFs, and phone extraction reports. These files are often messy, and carriers change their formats without telling anyone**.\* Track down bugs reported by customers and our support team. Reproduce the problem, find the real cause, fix it, and add a test that would have caught it. Work on the front end with Hotwire (Turbo and Stimulus) and plain JavaScript, including maps, timelines, and charts that sometimes have to draw hundreds of thousands of records. Write and maintain automated tests, and help keep the CI pipeline passing. Help move code from development to test to production, and keep an eye on it after it goes live. Work with our support staff and investigators, many of whom come from law enforcement, to learn how the software is used on real cases. Use AI coding tools as part of your daily work, and review what they produce as closely as you would review a teammate’s pull request**.\* Update documentation and runbooks when you change how something works. What You’ll Work With * Ruby 3\.x and Rails 8, with Hotwire (Turbo and Stimulus), import maps, and Solid Queue for background jobs. PostgreSQL, S3\-compatible object storage, and Apache Arrow for large datasets. JavaScript with D3, deck.gl, Google Maps, and Sigma.js for maps, charts, and link\-analysis graphs. Minitest and Capybara for application tests, and Playwright with TypeScript for end\-to\-end tests. Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, and Ansible for builds and deployments. Self\-hosted language models (vLLM, Ollama, and LiteLLM) that run features like our Ask Sarge assistant. Required Qualifications * 1 to 3 years of professional experience building web applications. A strong internship or co\-op can count toward this. Working knowledge of a server\-side web framework. Rails is ideal, but if you know Django, Laravel, Express, or something similar, you can pick up Rails here. Comfortable writing SQL and working with a relational database, preferably PostgreSQL. Solid fundamentals in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Everyday comfort with Git: commits, pull requests, and resolving merge conflicts. The habit of writing tests as part of the work, not after it. A methodical approach to debugging: read the logs, form a theory, check it, and say so plainly when you don’t know yet. Clear writing. You’ll write tickets, commit messages, and explanations for people who aren’t engineers. Good judgment and discretion with sensitive information. Our customers trust us with active criminal case data. Ability to pass a criminal background check. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with Ruby on Rails, especially Rails 7 or 8 and Hotwire. Experience with Docker. Exposure to Kubernetes, Jenkins, or another CI/CD system is a plus. Experience parsing and cleaning messy real\-world data in CSV, Excel, XML, JSON, or PDF form. Familiarity with geospatial data (coordinates, bearings, distance math) or with charting and mapping libraries like D3 or deck.gl. Curiosity about how large language models and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) work in practice. We run our own models in\-house. Any exposure to digital forensics, cellular networks, or the criminal justice system. It isn’t required. We’ll teach you the domain. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. *This job description outlines the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Duties may be modified at any time based on business needs.* Pay: $60,742\.41 \- $106,872\.57 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Phoenix, AZ 85016

jobs.description: **Title:** Data Visualization Engineer I **Client:** Georgia Power **Location:** Forest Park, GA **Contract:** 3 Years **Experience:** 3\+ Years Job Summary We are seeking a Data Visualization Engineer I / Data Analyst to design, develop, and maintain business intelligence solutions that transform enterprise data into actionable insights. This role will focus heavily on Power BI dashboard development, data modeling, SQL, Databricks, data integration, and reporting performance. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working with business stakeholders, data engineers, and IT teams to build accurate, scalable, and user\-friendly analytics solutions. Required Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field. * **3\+ years of experience** in data analytics, business intelligence, or reporting. * Strong experience with Microsoft Power BI. * Strong knowledge of: + DAX + Power Query + Data modeling + Dashboard development * Proficiency with SQL for querying, data manipulation, and optimization. * Experience with Databricks or similar modern data platforms. * Understanding of relational databases, data warehousing, and data pipelines. * Experience integrating data from multiple sources. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with Azure Databricks. * Knowledge of Python, Spark, or PySpark. * Experience with Git, source control, CI/CD, and BI deployment processes. * Experience supporting enterprise\-scale reporting environments. * Experience with dashboard and query performance optimization. jobs.title: Vibe Coder & Automation Wizard
jobs.description: **Job Summary** Your first thought when you see a repetitive task is, “I could automate that.” You build things just to see if they’ll work. And when an AI agent finally does exactly what you wanted? That’s a good day. We should talk. **A Day Back (adayback.ai)** helps service businesses get their time back through AI agents and automation. We’re hiring a **Founding Engineer / Junior AI Developer** to connect software, build useful agents, and turn everyday business headaches into tasks that practically handle themselves. We’re looking for an **obsessed vibe coder**. Someone who is constantly experimenting, learning new tools, and turning ideas into working solutions. You might be early in your career, but you’re already building things and have the coding foundation to understand, debug, and improve what AI produces. As our first technical hire, you’ll work directly with founder Matthew Poll. You’ll help build our company, work with clients, and see your projects make a difference in real businesses. **Location:** South Jordan / Salt Lake City, Utah. Local, on\-site work and in\-person client visits required. **Job type:** Full\-time. Available to start ASAP. **Salary:** $60,000–$100,000 per year, based on skills and experience. **Equity:** Potential opportunity after demonstrating strong performance and contribution. **Duties** * Build, configure, and improve AI agents that take repetitive work off people’s plates. * Connect client software, CRMs, and business tools through APIs and automation. * Attend in\-person client setups, typically around two hours for the initial appointment. * Talk with business owners and their teams to figure out where time gets wasted and what we can automate. * Get deep into our CRM and internal tools, then make them work better. * Troubleshoot problems, test your solutions, and make sure they keep working after the demo. * Explain what you’ve built in plain English and help clients feel comfortable using it. * Shadow client training sessions and webinars, then grow into leading them. * Help shape and build our long\-term product. * Document your work and handle client data, credentials, and access responsibly. **Skills** * Hands\-on experience building with AI coding tools and experimenting with AI agents. Experience with Grok Bot, Claw, OpenClaw, or similar tools is a plus. * A coding foundation that helps you read, troubleshoot, and improve AI\-generated code. * Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and workflow automation, plus the curiosity to learn unfamiliar systems. * Strong problem\-solving skills. When something breaks, you investigate, ask good questions, and work toward a fix. * Clear communication and confidence talking with clients on the phone, on video, and in person. * Creativity, initiative, and follow\-through. You can take an idea, build it, test it, and finish it. * Comfort with startup life: priorities evolve, you’ll wear several hats, and your ideas will matter. * Availability for full\-time, on\-site work in the South Jordan / Salt Lake City area. Personal projects count. Useful experiments count. That automation you built because doing something manually annoyed you? We want to hear about it. **Apply with your resume and a quick note about what you’ve built, which AI tools you use, and why this role sounds like your kind of work.** Include a project link or demo if you have one. Let’s give people their day back. Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Experience: * Vibe Coding: 1 year (Preferred) * Coding: 1 year (Required) Language: * English (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Lean AI, Industrial Engineer
jobs.description: **COMPANY DESCRIPTION** At AirLife, we are dedicated to improving the quality of every breath. *Excellence with Every Breath* is not just a tag line, but the way we work and take care of our customers. With a mindset to evolve, innovate, and grow, we are a premier manufacturer of the highest\-quality and market\-leading breathing consumables. This growth philosophy has positioned us to increase our global footprint and business reach, impacting even more people around the world. Our expanding family of the most trusted brands offers a product portfolio that spans the continuum of care from first responder to home care, with safety, patient comfort, and clinical performance in mind. Collective expertise allows us to provide quality products and experiences to our patients, customers, and our people. Our values of Customer first, Differentiate with our People, Bias for Action, Continuous Improvement and Accountability define who we are and how we work. Join us! **POSITION SUMMARY** The Industrial Engineer will provide engineering and project support to Distribution Centers by combining traditional industrial engineering methods with applied AI and advanced analytics. Drive labor optimization by improving productivity through engineered labor standards, AI\-driven forecasting and predictive models, KPI’s, automation technology, and continuous improvement initiatives supports day\-to\-day distribution center performance through data analytics, machine learning models, labor management analysis, and visual management tools. This role focuses on using statistical analysis, AI/ML techniques, and operational data to improve labor efficiency, productivity, predictive maintenance, and workflow visibility within the distribution center while supporting continuous improvement initiatives. **POSITION QUALIFICATIONS** **Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities:** * Distribution center/logistics concepts – understanding of warehousing best practices. * Ability to drive decision making through data and relevant business metrics. * Ability to resolve problems in a timely manner with little or no supervision. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work cross functionally. * Must be able to utilize problem solving techniques to identify root causes of failures and solutions to meet targets. * Strong business planning and analytical skills including market intelligence, metrics, financial and analysis. * Ability to manage project portfolio of varying priorities and impact value. * Strong computer skills including Power B.I, MS Office and MSD/MOST experience preferred; proficiency with Python, SQL, or similar tools for data analysis and predictive modeling a plus. * Experience applying machine learning or statistical modeling to operational problems (e.g., demand forecasting, labor forecasting, predictive maintenance) preferred. * Familiarity with simulation or discrete\-event modeling tools (e.g., Arena, FlexSim, AnyLogic) a plus. * Experience in developing engineered labor standards. * Continuous improvement experience and knowledge of CI methodologies preferred. * Experience within the distribution/warehouse/logistics industry preferred. * Proficient in RF Scanning and Warehouse Management Systems preferred. * Experience in semi and fully automated material handling systems a plus. **Level of Experience:** * 3\+ years of work experience in Industrial Engineering. * 1\+years of work experience with AI application in supply chain or similar **Level of Education:** * Bachelor's degree or higher in Industrial Engineering or equivalent degree such as Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Logistics is required. **Travel:** * Up to 10%. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Develop, validate, and maintain time\-studied standards for overall operation and for each function, leveraging AI\-assisted time\-and\-motion analysis and predictive labor models where applicable * Create a culture of performance management through leader standard work, productivity meetings and KPI * Provide training to operations teams on labor management and associated systems * Create a playbook of productivity improvements using CI/Lean principles and technology * Develop and deploy AI/ML\-based models (e.g., demand and labor forecasting, predictive maintenance) to support proactive, data\-driven decision\-making * Build and maintain automated, AI\-enabled dashboards and reporting tools to increase real\-time visibility into labor, throughput, and equipment KPIs * Write all SOP’s for operations and ensure employee training program in place * Evaluate and make recommendations on layouts, MHE and other equipment to optimize productivity, using simulation and AI\-driven scenario modeling to validate changes before implementation. **OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES** * Uphold and embody AirLife’s values in all aspects of work. * Demonstrate accuracy and thoroughness in daily work; look for ways to improve and promote quality \& safety. * Inspire the trust of others; treat people with respect and dignity and embrace the value of diversity. * Use time efficiently; perform job accurately, thoroughly, and conserve Company resources to improve profits. * Contribute to building and maintaining a positive team environment. * Assure all policies and guidelines are implemented and followed. **QUALITY POLICY** At AirLife, Quality is our promise. It is our commitment to customer satisfaction and our dedication to product excellence in an evolving global healthcare market. This promise is kept through a continuously improving and effective Quality Management System and compliance to Regulatory Requirements. **DEIA STATEMENT** At AirLife, we are committed to building a diverse workforce and an inclusive workplace that reflects the communities and customers we serve. We believe our philosophy on Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Advancement (DEIA) encourages excellence and equips us to serve an evolving global marketplace. **BENEFITS** AirLife offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), paid time off, paid holidays, bereavement leave, Employee Assistance Program resources, and medical leave benefits, subject to applicable eligibility requirements. Certain positions may also be eligible for bonus, commission, or other incentive compensation. **Please note:** The responsibilities outlined above are not exhaustive and may evolve over time. The role holder may be required to undertake additional duties as reasonably expected to meet the needs of the company.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management & Data Transformation
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- AMC Global Media is home to many of the greatest stories and characters in TV and film and the premier destination for passionate and engaged fan communities around the world. We create and curate celebrated series and films across distinct brands and make them available to audiences everywhere. Our portfolio includes targeted streaming services AMC\+, Acorn TV, Shudder, Sundance Now, ALLBLK and HIDIVE; cable networks AMC, BBC AMERICA, Independent Film Company, Sundance TV and We TV; and film distribution labels Independent Film Company and RLJE Films. The company also operates AMC Studios, our in\-house studio, production, and distribution operation behind acclaimed and fan\-favorite originals including The Walking Dead Universe and the Anne Rice Immortal Universe, and AMC Networks International, our international programming business. We are currently seeking a **Director, Product Management \& Data Transformation** to join ou**r Streaming Product \& Operations team** in our **New York, NY location.** **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:** **Data Product Strategy \& Transformation** * Define and execute a multi\-year Data Product and Analytics strategy aligned with AMC Global Media’s streaming business objectives. * Lead the transformation from fragmented reporting and instrumentation practices toward a governed, scalable, and trusted data ecosystem. * Establish product vision, roadmap, and prioritization for data products, analytics capabilities, KPI frameworks, and measurement infrastructure. * Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to embed data strategy into the broader Streaming Product roadmap. * Champion a culture of accountability, measurement, and data\-driven decision making across the organization. **KPI Governance \& Measurement** * Own the product strategy for AMC's KPI framework and measurement ecosystem. * Establish governance processes for metric definitions, ownership models, and reporting standards. * Partner with stakeholders to define North Star metrics, product KPIs, and business performance indicators across AMC\+, Shudder, Acorn TV, HIDIVE, and future products. * Ensure consistent metric definitions and reporting across platforms, brands, and teams. * Drive adoption of KPI ownership throughout the Product organization, leaning into product insights. **Data Governance \& Quality** * Partner with Data Engineering to establish a contract\-first approach to instrumentation, event taxonomy, and data quality. * Lead development of governance processes supporting semantic definitions, instrumentation standards, and data stewardship. * Establish frameworks for data validation, monitoring, audit processes, and issue remediation. * Co\-lead cross\-functional governance forums that drive accountability for data quality and reporting consistency. * Advocate for data quality as a product feature rather than an operational afterthought. **Instrumentation \& Analytics Platform Strategy** * Partner with Engineering teams to define instrumentation requirements, event taxonomies, and platform measurement standards. * Own the business roadmap for analytics platforms and supporting tooling. * Ensure instrumentation supports reliable measurement of customer engagement, retention, monetization, content consumption, and operational performance. * Collaborate with technical stakeholders to evaluate and prioritize investments in analytics infrastructure, semantic layers, governance tooling, and analytics platforms. **Data Literacy \& Organizational Enablement** * Help product managers, designers, engineers, and executives effectively leverage data to inform decisions. * Build training, documentation, and operating mechanisms that increase data fluency across teams. * Establish repeatable KPI reviews, business performance discussions, and product health assessments. * Promote self\-service analytics and democratized access to trusted business metrics. * Serve as an internal thought leader on measurement strategy and product analytics best practices. **Stakeholder Leadership** * Act as the primary business owner for Data Product initiatives across Streaming Product. * Present roadmap progress, data maturity goals, KPI health, and transformation outcomes to executive leadership. * Build alignment across Product, Data Engineering, Engineering, Marketing, CRM, and external partners. * Manage and mentor product managers and analysts supporting data initiatives. * Foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement. **QUALIFICATIONS (Required \& Preferred)** **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered. * 8\+ years of experience in Product Management, Analytics, Data Product Management, or related disciplines. * 3\+ years leading product, analytics, or data\-focused teams. * Experience building and scaling data products, analytics platforms, measurement frameworks, or data governance programs. * Deep understanding of KPI design, product analytics, instrumentation strategies, metric governance, and experimentation frameworks. * Strong ability to translate complex technical concepts into business outcomes. * Demonstrated success leading cross\-functional initiatives involving Product, Engineering, Data, and executive stakeholders. * Expertise establishing product operating rhythms, KPIs, and performance measurement systems. * Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and organizational leadership skills. **Preferred** * Experience with modern analytics ecosystems including Mixpanel, Amplitude, mParticle, dbt, semantic layers, event\-based analytics, and customer data platforms. * Entertainment industry experience a plus * Experience implementing data governance, instrumentation standards, or analytics transformation programs. * Familiarity with streaming, subscription, media, or digital platform businesses. * Knowledge of data quality, observability, taxonomy management, and event\-driven architecture. * Experience building data literacy programs and driving organizational adoption of data\-driven practices. * Understanding of AI, predictive analytics, and modern decision\-support systems. * MBA, Master’s degree, or advanced coursework in Data Science, Analytics, Product Management, Business, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience will also be considered. The base compensation for this position is **$190,000 \- $200,000** commensurate with experience. AMC Global Media additionally offers a comprehensive benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Paid Time Off, Paid Parental Leave and Adoption Services, among other benefit plan options, subject to eligibility requirements. AMC Global Media values the benefits achieved through in\-office collaboration, but we provide our employees with the flexibility to work from home one day per week.
