jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Purpose** *Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.* **Title and Summary** Principal Software Engineer Who is Mastercard? Mastercard is a global technology company powering an inclusive digital economy. Through secure networks, data\-driven insights, and innovative solutions, we enable safe, simple, and smart digital commerce across more than 210 countries and territories. Within Consumer Authentication Solutions (CAS), Mastercard delivers the critical authentication infrastructure that protects billions of digital transactions globally. CAS provides capabilities including EMV 3DS, Identity Check, Directory Services, Smart Authentication, tokenized authentication, issuer enablement, and risk\-based authentication. As a Principal Software Engineer, you serve as a distinguished technical leader responsible for shaping the architecture, engineering strategy, and long\-term technical direction of critical authentication platforms. You drive solutions to complex business and technical challenges, influence engineering decisions across multiple teams, and establish standards that improve the scalability, resiliency, security, and operational excellence of Mastercard's authentication ecosystem. This role requires deep technical expertise, exceptional system design skills, and the ability to lead through influence while mentoring engineers and advancing engineering excellence across the organization. Consistent with Principal SDE expectations, you are recognized as a technical authority, a trusted advisor, and a driver of innovation across large\-scale initiatives. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ Role Technical Leadership \& Architecture * Define and drive the long\-term technical vision for critical authentication and identity platforms. * Lead the architecture and design of highly scalable, resilient, distributed systems supporting global payment authentication services. * Establish engineering standards, reference architectures, design patterns, and best practices across multiple product and platform teams. * Make strategic technology decisions balancing performance, resiliency, security, maintainability, operational excellence, and speed to market. * Identify and solve complex technical challenges that span organizational and architectural boundaries. * Drive architectural evolution toward cloud\-native, event\-driven, and service\-oriented solutions. Engineering Excellence * Maintain meaningful hands\-on involvement while leading large technical initiatives and critical architectural efforts. * Champion high\-quality software engineering practices, code quality, automation, observability, and operational readiness. * Lead design reviews for major programs and provide guidance on technical tradeoffs, risk mitigation, and implementation approaches. * Ensure solutions are built with reliability, compliance, security, and scalability as foundational principles. * Drive adoption of modern engineering practices including CI/CD, automation\-first operations, and resilience engineering. Organizational Influence * Influence technical direction across multiple teams and business initiatives. * Partner closely with Product, Architecture, Security, Engineering, SRE, and Operational leaders to align technology strategy with business objectives. * Serve as a trusted advisor for large\-scale programs and enterprise\-level initiatives. * Foster collaboration across teams and drive consensus on complex technical decisions. * Represent engineering strategy and architectural recommendations to senior leadership and executive stakeholders. Mentorship \& Talent Development * Provide technical mentorship to senior engineers, lead engineers, and engineering leaders. * Raise engineering capability across the organization through coaching, design guidance, and technical leadership. * Promote a culture of innovation, collaboration, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence. * Contribute significantly to onboarding, knowledge sharing, and development of technical talent. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ About You Technical Expertise * Recognized technical expert with a proven track record leading large\-scale software engineering initiatives. * Deep expertise in distributed systems architecture, microservices, Domain\-Driven Design (DDD), and enterprise application development. * Advanced experience designing highly available, fault\-tolerant, and globally distributed systems. *  ertise with event\-driven architectures and messaging technologies such as Kafka, NATS, and MQ. * Strong understanding of performance engineering, system scalability, reliability patterns, and resiliency design. * Experience implementing secure software development practices and enterprise\-grade security controls. * Deep understanding of observability, monitoring, incident management, disaster recovery, and operational excellence. Leadership \& Collaboration * Proven ability to lead large, complex engineering efforts involving multiple teams, stakeholders, and business functions. * Skilled at driving consensus and influencing technical decisions without direct authority. * Highly regarded mentor and advisor with a demonstrated commitment to developing engineering talent. * Excellent communicator capable of translating complex technical concepts for engineering, business, and executive audiences. * Maintains awareness of emerging technologies, industry trends, and engineering best practices, applying them to create business value. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ Education Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field. Experience within payments, fintech, digital identity, authentication, or high\-scale transaction processing environments is strongly preferred. Mastercard is a merit\-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable\_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.**Corporate Security Responsibility** All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: * Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; * Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; * Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and * Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro\-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best\-in\-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on\-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on\-site fitness facilities in some locations.**Pay Ranges** O'Fallon, Missouri: $170,000 \- $281,000 USD

jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description: The specific pay rate and level will depend on the successful candidate’s qualifications, prior experience and location. **“A Day in the Life”** Located at the Corporate office in Livermore, California Based at our Corporate office in Livermore, California, the Network Engineer you will configure, maintain, collaborate and troubleshoot our Cisco\-based network infrastructures integrated voice, video, collaboration, security, and data systems. You will also ensure the availability, security, and efficiency of network operations in the organization to include proactive monitoring and advising manager and team of alerts, network failure, or degradations that occur. Ability to open vendor support tickets with Cisco, various vendors, and data network carriers. Strong understanding of cabling requirements for facilities and ability to document needs and work with vendor to provide quotes and follow through until work has been completed. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Enterprise Cisco networking technology, including routing, switching, firewalls, VPN, and SASE configurations. Will generate and distribute network performance stats and monitor system output and utilization statistics for optimal function. **“What You’ll Do”** * Assists in the installation and maintenance of network communications, configuring various network devices and services * Troubleshoot network issues within established guidelines * Assist with network architecture, optimization, and cost management * Design, implement and troubleshoot Wi\-Fi and security infrastructure * Perform asset management/maintenance functions * Attention to detail, accuracy, strong organizational skills and desire for continuous improvement and learning * Promotes an environment of excellent internal and external customer service * Strong understanding of ITIL ticketing systems including ticket management and change control * Time management * Ability to manage several projects simultaneously from design to implementation * Perform other duties as assigned **“Must Haves”** * Minimum of 6\-10 years’ experience in Enterprise Network Engineering. * Minimum of 3\-5 years’ experience configuring, installing, and supporting Cisco Catalyst and Meraki network routers, switches, wireless access points. * Minimum of 2\-4 years’ experience with Cisco SASE experience, designing, deploying, managing cloud\-delivered security and software defined WAN architecture. Ideal candidate combines core routing and switching expertise with cloud security integration using Cisco SD\-WAN and Cisco Umbrella/SSE. * Advanced proficiency in Cisco SD\-WAN components (vManage, vBond, vSmart, WAN Edge) and Cisco security solutions (Umbrella, Duo, Secure Firewall). * Deep understanding of data networking principles including but not limited to: BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IPSec tunnels, QoS, TCP/IP stack behavior, firewall policies, SIP Trunks, and cloud management network administration/configuration. * Ability to build and deploy scalable Cisco SD\-WAN and SASE frameworks combining secure edge routing, cloud firewalls, and zero\-trust network access (ZTNA). * Experience with Cisco Call Manager, Call Gateways, SRST, Webex Calling, Webex Control Hub, or similar UCaaS administration is a plus. * Experience administering Cisco Meraki Dashboard for security, SD\-WAN, switching, wireless, monitoring, reporting, firmware management, and troubleshooting. * Experience with Solarwinds and Cisco Meraki Dashboard environments * Experience with carrier installations and troubleshooting. * Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, and ability to present to an audience * Ability to effectively interact with internal business users and external vendors * Able to work independently and within a team environment to see projects through to completion * Proven dedication to internal and external customer service * Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, with an ability to multi\-task and prioritize in a fast\-paced environment * Able to use sound and accurate decision\-making skills **“Nice to Haves”** * Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or related major preferred * Cisco CCNA is a plus; Cisco Meraki Solutions Specialist, CCNP Enterprise, CCNP Security, or Cisco collaboration/Webex administration training is preferred * ITIL Foundations certification is a plus **“Perks”** * It’s a great place to work where you are given the space to share ideas and opinions and the bottom\-line is “YOU” matter! * We value our employees' Quality of Life, and when it comes to mental health, recovery, and self\-care, there is no one\-size\-fits\-all approach that is why we provide resources where employees can find information on several wellness topics like nutrition, exercise, emotional health, and more! * We all need to rest and recharge, that’s why in addition to vacation and sick time we also offer 10 days \+ 2 half days company\-paid holidays! * We offer a variety of benefits that offer you flexibility and choice, a simple selection experience, and the ability to take control over your benefit spending. * 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match. * Life is unpredictable, having Company Paid Life Insurance and knowing that your loved ones will be protected financially in the event of an unexpected death can give you peace of mind. * We also offer DailyPay, HSA, FSA, EAP and Pet Insurance! **Flexibility \& Evolving Responsibilities** This job posting is intended to convey the general nature and level of work expected in the role. It is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee. Responsibilities may evolve over time, and team members may be asked to take on additional tasks or adjust their focus in response to changing business needs—sometimes with or without prior notice. This flexibility is a valued part of our culture and supports our commitment to collaboration, agility, and shared success. **Equal Employment Opportunity \& Hiring Requirements** Pre\-employment screenings are conducted after a conditional offer of employment is extended, in accordance with fair hiring laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, on the basis of disability and any other legally protected status. We are interested in every qualified candidate who is legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. At this time, we do not sponsor employment visas or provide immigration sponsorship now or in the future. Our company uses E\-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. **AI Use in Our Interview Process** You are welcome to use AI tools to prepare in advance for our interview process. During interviews, however, candidates should respond based on their own knowledge, experience, and perspective without real\-time assistance from AI or another person. This helps us have an authentic conversation and evaluate candidates consistently. If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, please let us know. \#MGRC \#LI\-Hybrid

We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best. The Senior Software Quality Assurance Engineer provides independent Quality oversight and advanced technical guidance for the development, validation, release, and post\-market maintenance of software\-based medical devices throughout the product lifecycle. This role independently leads complex software Quality activities within established quality system and software lifecycle frameworks such as reviewing software requirements, testing strategies, cybersecurity controls and validation; while supporting continuous improvement. jobs.description: **Engineer, Combustion Tuning** **Company Overview** At Mitsubishi Power, we're not just building better clean energy technologies; we're architecting a better future. This role specializes in combustion tuning, emissions optimization, combustion dynamics mitigation, and operational performance improvement of Mitsubishi Power gas turbine fleet. Responsibilities include analyzing combustion and turbine operating data, developing and implementing tuning strategies, supporting field startup and commissioning activities, diagnosing combustion\-related issues, and ensuring reliable, compliant turbine operation across a range of operating conditions. **Key Responsibilities** * These duties and responsibilities are in addition to Engineer I and Engineer II, Turbine Controls. * Have a thorough understanding of the theory of the combustion process in industrial/large frame gas turbines. * Have a thorough knowledge of the combustion dynamics that occur in an industrial/large frame gas turbine. * High\-level knowledge and capabilities within Digital Control Systems (Netmation, Ovation, SPPA\-T3000, TXP, Speedtronic Mark VI/VIe, etc.). * Knowledge of control and complex areas within control scheme as well as use and application as it relates to operation and troubleshooting for onsite execution. * Able to perform combustion tuning on all classes of Mitsubishi Power gas turbines. This is to include the procedure for tuning, the process to perform countermeasures for pressure fluctuations encountered, and performance of special tuning such as load overshoot and Fuel Gas Temperature tuning. * Knowledge and application of advanced control concepts such as Cascade Control, Feed Forward, PID tuning, bumpless transfers, etc. * Have a thorough knowledge of the administrative requirements at the completion of combustion tuning to include customer and internal reporting. * Provide start\-up commissioning, operations and/or troubleshooting support for equipment failures and determine root cause analysis and implement solutions. * Perform on\-site combustion tuning of Mitsubishi Power gas turbines, using knowledge of combustion dynamics and Mitsubishi combustion tuning software. * Provide calibration of field devices. * Verify slot assignment, output, transmitter, failsafe structure, connections, display, system/loop check, operational, functional and tuning of Mitsubishi Power GT controllers. * Program Mitsubishi logic controllers. * Perform instrument loop calculation and operation set points. * Prepare and submit accurate reports regarding conditions, required actions and obtained results. * Review of other teams members controls and tuning reports for accuracy; * Perform other such duties as may be required. * Heavy overnight travel (at least 70%) by land and/or air. **Other Duties and Responsibilities** * Comply with all safety policies, practices and procedures, reporting all unsafe activities to Management and/or Human Resources. * Participate in proactive team efforts to achieve departmental and company goals. * Contribute to building a positive team spirit. * Communicate effectively with all levels of employees. * Protect confidential information by not communicating, disclosing to, or using it for the benefit of third parties. * Always maintain the highest degree of honesty and integrity. **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree (BA) in Engineering from four\-year college or university plus three (3\) years of experience; or at least five (5\) years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience. In lieu of experience, the candidate will have successfully completed the Controls and Tuning Training Development Program. * Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public. * Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations. * Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables. * Knowledge of database, project management, spreadsheet and word processing software, electronic mail, graphics, technical diagrams, flow charts, etc. * Travel is required in this role, as you will be assigned to be on\-site during outages **Why Should You Apply?** * Excellent Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision \& 401K Matching). * Excellent development programs and advancement opportunities. * Tuition reimbursement and on\-the\-job training. * Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays. * Committed to quality products and services. * Great working environment and culture. * Employee Appreciation Programs and Event. jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer - Wireless & Physical Security
jobs.description: Build systems people can depend on A dependable network gives people the confidence to get on with their work. At Modern IT, you will turn client needs into carefully implemented infrastructure—from network equipment and wireless coverage to internet connectivity, cameras, and physical access systems. You will develop designs for an architect’s approval, then own implementation, testing, and handoff. Coordinate provider readiness, site dependencies, cutover, validation, and handoff. Keep delivery records accurate to support the commercial process. **Cameras and connected security:** Develop and implement architect\-approved UniFi Protect, UniFi Access, environmental sensor, and related IoT solutions. Validate agreed coverage, recording, permissions, connectivity, supported integrations, and failure behavior. Coordinate specialist dependencies. **Subcontractor Management:** Set clear scope and acceptance criteria, inspect work, and drive deficiencies to resolution. You can reject work that falls short of agreed standards; explain the gap respectfully and establish a practical correction plan that protects outcomes and relationships. **Operational handoff:** Deliver accurate as\-built records, configuration documentation, test results, and a clear support handoff. Participate in complex escalations when needed and bring root\-cause learning into future implementations. What good work looks like Implementations pass agreed acceptance testing and meet approved designs. Material deficiencies are resolved before handoff. As our cabling and connected\-infrastructure work grows, you will help develop a repeatable delivery capability: clear scopes, dependable subcontractor relationships, quality standards, and a practical plan for expanding what Modern IT can deliver. C\-7 licensing or qualifying\-individual experience is a strong advantage. **Requirements** You bring hands\-on experience with: * Network implementation and troubleshooting across routing, switching, firewalls, segmentation, and device connectivity, including UniFi and Meraki environments. * Wireless site surveys, design, deployment, and performance validation. * UniFi Protect, UniFi Access, IoT, and physical\-security implementations. * ISP installations and migrations, including provider coordination, cutover planning, validation, and handoff. * Subcontractor coordination, quality inspection, and constructive resolution of deficient work. * C\-7 licensing or qualifying\-individual experience is preferred, not required to apply. * Applying AI to engineering processes, such as test plans, documentation, and repeatable workflows. You validate technical outputs, protect client information, and remain responsible for the result. You can explain work you personally delivered: the design, approval process, implementation choices, testing, and handoff. You communicate clearly with clients and colleagues, work within architect\-approved designs, and document systems so others can support them. **Benefits** Base salary: $150,000–$180,000 annually, based on relevant experience and demonstrated capabilities. You may be eligible to participate in Modern IT’s profit\-sharing plan after six months of employment, subject to plan terms. Payouts are not guaranteed. A company vehicle is available for work\-related travel. Travel and vehicle expenses are handled under Modern IT’s policy in accordance with applicable IRS rules. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Why Mozilla?** Mozilla Corporation is the non\-profit\-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy\-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non\-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute **open\-source** software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. **About this role:** As a Senior Software Engineer on the Ecosystem Services Team, you’ll build and own back\-end systems and the integrations that keep our services running, help maintain and evolve the cloud infrastructure the application runs on, and play an active role in keeping the service reliable and healthy in production. You'll do this while collaborating closely with frontend engineers, product managers, CloudEng, and UX and design partners to deliver reliable features. We are looking for engineers who treat the systems they build as their own: people who are comfortable owning a service end to end, from writing the code to verifying it works as intended in production and monitoring its health. We are hiring for multiple Ecosystem Services Team back\-end teams \- each solving their own unique challenges to make the web better for everyone. More details about all hiring teams will be shared in the interviews. **About Ecosystem Services:** Ecosystem Services builds and operates the back\-end platforms that power Mozilla products and services, with a focus on privacy, security, and delivering critical functionality to Firefox and millions of users worldwide. Our portfolio spans a diverse set of platforms and services. Representative examples include Privacy Services, which provides the APIs and infrastructure behind Mozilla VPN, Relay (email and phone aliasing), and Monitor (data breach detection and remediation); AutoPush, Mozilla's Web Push platform for securely delivering notifications and real\-time updates to Firefox clients; and Remote Settings, Mozilla's platform for delivering configuration updates to Firefox outside the regular release cycle. Together with many other backend platforms across the organization, these services help deliver secure, reliable experiences to Mozilla users every day. Our teams own services end\-to\-end from designing and building distributed systems, to operating them in production, improving reliability, and evolving the cloud infrastructure they run on. We work closely with product, frontend engineering, Cloud Engineering, UX, and design partners to build resilient systems that make the web better for everyone. jobs.title: Security Architect - New College Grad 2026
jobs.description: NVIDIA is seeking a Security Architect to join the team defining and advancing security architecture for our pioneering SoCs and GPUs. In this role, you will work with experienced security architects and multi\-functional engineering teams to help evaluate platform security requirements, support security certification efforts, and provide to secure designs across automotive, gaming, and server platforms. You will gain hands on experience in security certification and assurance programs, silicon security, secure boot, measured boot, hardware root of trust, cryptography, CPU security architecture, and SoC security design. You will also help build and apply AI assisted tools that improve how security architecture work is done, including design review support, specification analysis, threat modeling workflows, certification evidence tracking, and security knowledge retrieval. **What you'll be doing:** * Support security certification and compliance efforts for NVIDIA chips and platforms, including FIPS 140\-3, EU CRA, ISO 21434, Caliptra trademark audit, and related assurance programs. * Assist with certification documentation, implementation tracking, evidence collection, compliance mapping, and coordination with internal teams, external labs, auditors, and certification partners. * Help translate security requirements and certification expectations into practical engineering mentorship for hardware, firmware, and software teams. * Review architecture, verification, and firewall specifications with guidance from senior architects to help assess whether IPs meet platform security requirements. * Contribute to threat modeling by identifying trust boundaries, attack surfaces, assets, assumptions, and potential mitigations. * Contribute to security architecture documentation, design review checklists, certification materials, compliance mappings, and internal guidance. * Collaborate with security architects, hardware teams, software teams, verification teams, and product teams to help evaluate platform security requirements. * Build and improve tools and workflows enhanced by artificial intelligence. These help security architects review specifications, identify security requirements, summarize technical evidence, and scale threat modeling across advanced SoC and GPU programs. * Explore practical uses of LLMs and automation to improve security architecture productivity while protecting confidential design information and maintaining engineering rigor. **What we need to see:** * Pursuing or recently completed a BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * Strong foundation in computer architecture, digital logic, operating systems, embedded systems, or computer security. * Coursework, internship, research, project, or equivalent experience in security, computer architecture, hardware design, or cryptography. * Programming and debugging fundamentals in one or more of C, C\+\+, Python, Verilog, System Verilog, ARM assembly, RISC V assembly, or scripting languages. * Strong analytical, reasoning, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills for working across engineering teams. * Curiosity and genuine interest in learning security architecture for sophisticated SoCs and GPUs. * Interest in learning how AI tools and automation can improve engineering workflows, including documentation, analysis, and security review tasks. **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Exposure to SoC security or platform security concepts such as secure boot, measured boot, hardware root of trust, key management, debug security, isolation, or memory protection. * Understanding of cryptographic algorithms, standards, implementations, and secure protocol usage. * Experience with threat modeling, vulnerability research, CTFs, secure design review, or security testing. * Experience with ASIC design concepts, RTL, verification, and embedded firmware. * Experience building AI assisted engineering tools, automation scripts, retrieval systems, agents, evaluation workflows, or tools designed to improve efficiency for code, technical writing, architectural assessment, verification, or security analysis. NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We work on problems that matter with some of the most talented engineers in the world. If you're creative, analytically sharp, intellectually curious, and ready to grow into a security architect working on state of the art silicon security, we want to hear from you. The base salary range is 108,000 USD \- 178,250 USD for Level 1, and 124,000 USD \- 195,500 USD for Level 2\. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Provide support on usage of NXP hardware platforms, reference designs, and software deliverables including u\-boot, Linux \& Android. * Understand customer requests and participate to the NXP product enhancement (NPI Process) In addition you will contribute to the development of firmware, demos and all materials enhancing our product offering to our customers: * build application / demos / drivers porting or development on innovative multimedia, connectivity, infotainment with the i.MX processor family. * build innovative functions or use case demonstrators in all applications fields: video, connectivity… * perform technical feasibility studies on key functions * build reference designs in various strategic domains, application notes and white papers writing. * review Reference Manuals and Data Sheets and contribute to Developer guides and "Ease\-of\-use" manuals. **Specific Knowledge/Skills** Must have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering or Computer Science. NYL360 is New York Life’s connected digital experience for the field, bringing together the tools, information, and insights advisors use every day in one place. Today, wealth products, tools, and processes often take a back seat to life insurance within the advisor experience — and the current environment is complex to navigate. You will own the effort to change that: ensuring wealth is prominently represented, thoughtfully designed, and easy to understand within the platform, in direct support of New York Life’s goal of Protection Powered Growth. You will work closely with other Product Owners, Designers, Engineers, data teams, testing teams, and field stakeholders to turn advisor wealth needs into well\-defined, deliverable features. This is a fast\-moving transformation effort, and what the team builds will fundamentally change how advisors sell, service, and manage wealth business every day. **What You’ll Do** **Shape the Work Through Prototypes** * Partner with Design to turn high\-level epics into working prototypes in place of traditional requirements documentation. * Define \& codify “what good looks like” for wealth products and tools — advisor needs, business rules, data requirements, and access — with an eye toward simplifying a complex operating environment. * Refine the stories that come out of the prototype into clear scope and acceptance criteria for engineering. * Keep the backlog ready for weekly sprint planning. **Coordinate Across Business, Field \& Technology Teams** * Work in partnership with Design, Engineering, Data \& Testing teams with fewer handoffs than traditional delivery models. * Work directly with advisors, wealth product partners, and other field stakeholders to validate workflows and gather feedback. * Flag dependencies, risks, and open decisions early enough for the team to act — particularly where wealth processes intersect with legacy systems or life insurance workflows. **Keep Weekly Delivery Moving** * Participate in weekly sprint planning, stand\-ups, demos, and retrospectives. * Answer questions and close requirement gaps in the moment so development keeps moving on a one\-week cycle. * Use AI tools in your own product work. methodology and tools such as Jira preferred. * Uses AI tools in day\-to\-day work and looks for ways to apply them across product, design, and delivery. * Strong attention to detail around data jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Frontend
jobs.description: Staff Software Engineer, Frontend Location: Austin, TX, United States Category: Consumer Experience \& Customer Care Job ID: 3261 Apply Now Description Staff Software Engineer, Frontend — Authentication \& Identity At realtor.com®, sign\-in is the front door. Every saved home, every saved search, every personalized recommendation and every lead depends on knowing who the consumer is — across web, mobile web and native, and across every subdomain we operate. We are looking for a Staff Engineer to serve as the technical anchor for the frontend of our Authentication \& Identity platform, owning the client\-side architecture that millions of authenticated sessions pass through every day. The Role As a Staff Engineer, you won't just write code; you will define how authentication is built and consumed across every consumer surface at realtor.com®. Auth is the one system every team depends on and no team wants to own — you will own it, and you will make it something other engineers reach for rather than route around. You will balance hands\-on development with high\-level system design, ensuring identity is seamless for consumers and boring for the engineers who integrate with it. Architectural Leadership: Own the end\-to\-end client architecture of our identity platform — our React/Next.js consumer web surfaces, the shared auth libraries every other team consumes, and their integration with Auth0 and our GraphQL gateway. We are actively consolidating multiple co\-existing auth implementations onto one platform; you will lead that convergence and decide what the single path looks like. Auth at Scale, Without Friction: Drive the client\-side work behind new authentication methods — passkeys/WebAuthn, one\-time passcodes, social and federated sign\-in — and own token lifecycle, session continuity and cross\-subdomain identity in the browser. You are responsible for both halves of the tradeoff: reducing forced sign\-outs and abandoned registrations while holding the security line on OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, PKCE and token handling. Reliability and Observability: Auth failures are silent, and users don't file tickets — they leave. You will define what "healthy" means for the sign\-in path, instrument it, and make regressions visible before they show up in conversion. You will lead frontend resiliency and error\-strategy work so that a degraded dependency downgrades the experience instead of ending the session. AI Strategy \& Governance: Lead the integration of AI coding assistants and LLMs into the SDLC. You are responsible for the "human\-in\-the\-loop" verification of AI\-generated code regarding security, performance, and long\-term maintainability — a bar that is higher, not lower, in code that mints and stores credentials. Cross\-Functional Influence: Partner with Product, Security, Data Science and Design, and with the platform teams who consume your libraries. Much of your impact lands through other teams' repositories, which means influence, clear architecture docs and RFCs matter as much as your own commits. About You Technical Mastery: 8\+ years of experience (8\+ in modern stacks) with deep expertise in production React architectures and in browser\-based authentication — OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, PKCE, token storage and refresh, session and cookie semantics, and the failure modes each of them has in the real world. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. Identity Depth: Hands\-on experience with a managed identity provider (Auth0, Okta, Cognito or equivalent) beyond the happy path — migrations between providers or auth systems, custom login flows, bot protection, step\-up verification, and the anonymous\-to\-known user transition. Systems Thinker: You reason about identity as a distributed system, not a login form. Comfortable with cloud\-native design (AWS), micro\-frontend and shared\-library boundaries, versioning and rollout of code that other teams depend on, and building for "the next 10x" of traffic. Operational Excellence: Deep understanding of automated deployment, progressive rollout behind feature flags, and instrumentation. You have run a high\-risk migration on a live, high\-traffic path and know how to ramp it, watch it, and roll it back. Mentorship \& Culture: A natural leader who raises the bar for the entire engineering organization through code reviews, RFCs, and a growth\-oriented mindset — including for the many engineers outside your team who integrate with your platform. Data\-Driven: Professional experience implementing complex A/B testing frameworks and deriving actionable insights from high\-volume traffic data, and the judgment to know when an auth change must not be A/B tested at all. How We Reward You Comprehensive Health: Medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage from day one. Financial Future: 401(k) with 3\.5% match and a unique Student Debt Retirement Savings Match. Balance: Flexible Time Off, 13 Paid Holidays, and 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time. Growth: Tuition reimbursement and 1:1 personalized financial planning. Apply Now

jobs.title: Network, Infrastructure & Security Manager
jobs.description: Description: We are looking for a hands\-on Network, Infrastructure \& Security Manager to take ownership of the infrastructure supporting a growing, multi\-location healthcare organization. This is not a position where you will spend your day managing a team from a spreadsheet. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving difficult technical problems. One day you may be troubleshooting a firewall or connectivity problem. The next you may be investigating a security alert, working with an ISP, reviewing a network design, troubleshooting an API with a software vendor, or figuring out why two systems that worked yesterday suddenly stopped communicating. If you are the person people call when the problem has already been escalated twice, you may be a great fit for this role. **What You'll Own** You will be responsible for the reliability, security, documentation, and continued improvement of our network and infrastructure environment. Your responsibilities will include: * Firewalls, switches, routing, VLANs, Wi\-Fi and WAN connectivity * Multi\-location network infrastructure * ISP management, outages and failover connectivity * VPN and secure remote access * Microsoft Azure networking and hybrid infrastructure * Microsoft 365, Entra ID and Active Directory infrastructure * Network segmentation and infrastructure security * Infrastructure monitoring and performance * EDR and other security technologies * Vulnerability remediation * Network and infrastructure documentation * Equipment lifecycle and capacity planning * Technical vendor management and escalation * Support for cybersecurity incident response * New location and infrastructure deployments We also need someone comfortable troubleshooting problems beyond the network. Our systems rely heavily on integrations with third\-party technology vendors. You will help troubleshoot APIs, web services, webhooks, SFTP transfers, authentication, certificates, interface failures and other system\-to\-system connectivity issues. You don't need to be a software developer, but you should be comfortable looking at an HTTP 500 error, opening Postman, reading JSON or XML, reviewing logs, testing an endpoint, checking DNS/TLS/connectivity and working with a vendor engineer to determine where the problem actually lives. **Cybersecurity** Security is an important part of this position. You will help manage and improve technical security controls, investigate suspicious activity, coordinate remediation, maintain secure infrastructure configurations and participate in incident response. We also use external cybersecurity specialists for independent security reviews, penetration testing and assessments. You will work directly with these teams and take ownership of remediating technical findings. Requirements: What We're Looking For We are looking for someone with strong hands\-on experience in areas such as: * TCP/IP, routing and switching * Enterprise firewalls * VLANs and network segmentation * DNS/DHCP * VPN and remote access * Microsoft 365 / Entra ID / Active Directory * Azure networking * Endpoint security / EDR * Vulnerability remediation * REST APIs and web services * HTTP/HTTPS * JSON/XML * OAuth/SAML * TLS certificates * SFTP * Postman or similar tools * PowerShell * SQL * Network and application logs Experience with CrowdStrike, Microsoft security technologies, Citrix, Parallels RAS, healthcare IT, EHR systems, HL7 or interface engines is a plus. Relevant certifications such as CCNA/CCNP, Security\+, CISSP or Microsoft Azure certifications are beneficial, but we value demonstrated technical ability and problem\-solving skills more than a list of certifications. Who Will Do Well Here You'll probably enjoy this position if you: * Like troubleshooting difficult problems rather than immediately escalating them. * Want ownership of an environment instead of responsibility for one small piece of it. * Can move comfortably between networking, security, cloud and application troubleshooting. * Know when to use Wireshark, PowerShell, Postman or a log file to answer a question instead of guessing. * Can work directly with vendor engineers and hold vendors accountable for resolving issues. * Document what you build and troubleshoot. * Can explain a complex technical problem clearly to someone who isn't technical. * Understand that healthcare technology needs to be both secure and available. * Are comfortable being the senior technical escalation point before an issue reaches the CTO. This position reports directly to the Chief Technology Officer and will have meaningful ownership of the organization's technical infrastructure. We're looking for someone who wants to understand how the entire environment works, improve it, secure it and take responsibility for keeping it running.

jobs.description: Since 2004, OSIbeyond has provided managed technology and cybersecurity services to commercial organizations, nonprofits, associations, and government contractors, guided by a founding principle that outstanding technical expertise must be matched by an exceptional client experience. That commitment is delivered today through OSIbeyond ONE, an integrated technology platform that unifies IT operations, cybersecurity, Microsoft 365, cloud services, automation, artificial intelligence, and expert support within a single, continuously managed operating environment. The platform is founded on a defined operating philosophy: Automation First. AI Enabled. People Powered. Within OSIbeyond ONE, routine technology requests are increasingly fulfilled through intelligent monitoring, AI\-assisted ticket processing, and automated service workflows, and OSIbeyond continuously invests in expanding these capabilities. The Level 2 (Human Support) Engineer represents the human expertise at the center of this model. The position provides oversight and authorization for automated helpdesk/user support workflows, delivers live technical support to end users when automation is not applicable, and performs system/network administration support across a diverse portfolio of client environments. This position is intended for an accomplished technical professional who seeks to apply their expertise within a modern, automation\-driven service delivery model. The successful candidate will demonstrate sound technical judgment, a commitment to accuracy and accountability, professionalism in client communication, and an interest in the continued advancement of AI and automation in managed technology services. **About the Role:** The Level 2 (Human Support) Engineer is responsible for the delivery of high\-quality technical support to OSIbeyond clients across two service domains: helpdesk/user support and system/network administration support. Within helpdesk/user support, approximately 90% of requests are fulfilled through automated workflows. Certain requests received by phone are fulfilled by completing a request form that initiates the corresponding automation. For these requests, the Level 2 (Human Support) Engineer serves as the point of human validation, reviewing the request parameters identified by the AI\-assisted ticketing process, confirming their accuracy, authorizing execution of the automated workflow, and verifying the outcome. Clients subject to regulatory compliance requirements are excluded from automated fulfillment; requests for these clients are completed manually. The remaining requests, approximately 10%, require direct engagement with the end user. For these, the Level 2 (Human Support) Engineer provides live telephone and remote support, taking ownership of the request from initial contact through resolution. Although live support represents roughly 10% of helpdesk request volume, it accounts for approximately 80% of the Level 2 (Human Support) Engineer's workday. Within system/network administration support, the Level 2 (Human Support) Engineer resolves administrative requests and escalations involving identity, Microsoft 365, server, and network environments, operating within established procedures and escalating to senior engineering staff where appropriate. These advanced tasks will be completed through the use of various tools and Standard Operating Procedure documents. As OSIbeyond continues to engineer additional automation and AI capabilities into the OSIbeyond ONE platform, the scope of helpdesk/user support work fulfilled through automation is expected to expand. The Level 2 (Human Support) Engineer contributes to this progression by identifying recurring manual work suitable for automation, coordinating with automation engineers, and validating new workflows prior to and following release. jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Member Experience
jobs.description: Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease. **Job Overview:** ----------------- We are hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to own a significant piece of Omada's Member\-facing surface. You own what gets built, in what order, and how the people building it grow. A squad owns problems from prototype to production, including the maintenance and the on\-call rotation for what it ships. At this level you own more than one, which means the hardest calls you make are the ones about where capacity goes when two good things want it at the same time. You stay technical. You are in the codebase and in the same agent workflows your builders use, close enough to review architecture, catch a weak design, and be useful in an incident. Where you manage directly, you ship production work off the critical path. Where you manage through someone else, that person's growth is your work product. You partner with Product Strategists who spend their time in front of members, coaches, and stakeholders, and who prototype to test ideas quickly. They own what gets built and why. You own whether it can be delivered, at what cost, and by when, and you are senior enough that your answer shapes the roadmap rather than just responding to it. **About you:** -------------- You are comfortable being accountable for what your squads ship. You still write code, and you want to. This role ships production work off the critical path, in the same codebase and the same agent workflows as your squads, so you feel the friction your people feel first\-hand. You have a point of view on where AI\-assisted development helps and where it creates rework, and it comes from changing how a real team works, not from reading about it. You have done the engineering manager job well enough that you can teach it. Whether or not you have carried the title of manager\-of\-managers, you have grown someone into leading, and you know the difference between doing the work for them and raising their ceiling. Your first team is your peer group, not your reports. When something is slowing down the engineering org and it is nobody's job, you have a track record of picking it up, getting the right people in the room, and finishing it. **What you'll be doing:** ------------------------- * **Own delivery across your squads.** Sprint shaping, prioritization, backlog grooming, and estimation. Make the calls, write them down, and be accountable for them. When two squads want the same thing at the same time, you are the one who decides. * **Own cycle time.** Yours to improve, not at the expense of quality, and yours to explain when it changes, including why one of your squads is slower than the other. * **Stay technical.** On squads you manage directly, you ship production work every sprint, off the critical path, in the same agent workflows your builders use. On squads that run through a manager, you stay close enough to review architecture, catch a weak design, and be useful in an incident. Either way, you can teach someone to navigate the system, not just navigate it yourself. * **Partner with your Product Strategist.** They own what the squad builds; you hold the line between their scope and yours so the squad never has two people answering the same question differently. * **Grow a manager.** If an EM reports to you, their growth is your work product. Their squad's health is the evidence. * **Plan the team you need next year, not just this quarter.** Headcount, skill mix, and the onboarding path that gets a new builder productive in an agent\-heavy codebase in weeks rather than months. * **Set the AI standard past your own boundary.** Write down what good looks like, teach it, and measure whether it stuck. Other squads should be able to use what you built without you in the room. * **Take on the problem that is nobody's.** You will find things that slow down engineering broadly. Some of them you should pick up, organize, and close out with your peers. **What you need for this role:** -------------------------------- * 8\+ years in software engineering, including 4\+ years managing engineers directly. * Experience developing another leader: a manager who reported to you, or an engineer you grew into a tech lead or EM role with real accountability attached. Tell us where they are now. * A track record shipping mission\-critical software to production, and living with it afterwards. We all make mistakes; what sets you apart is that you own yours and turn them into something better. * Experience owning prioritization and estimation for a team, including saying no, not now, and explaining why. * Experience giving direct developmental feedback, and at least one case where you managed someone through underperformance with real support attached. * Currently shipping, or recently shipping, production code in at least one layer of our stack (backend (Ruby, Python, ...), web frontends (React), iOS, or Android,) with enough range to follow the conversation in the ot b, Datadog, PagerDuty. **Benefits:** * Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus * Equity grants * Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP) * Remote first work from home culture * Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones * Generous parental leave * Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions) * 401k retirement savings plan * Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA) * Mental Health Support Solutions * ...and more! It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day\-to\-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada! * **Cultivate Trust.** We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other. * **Seek Context.** We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road. * **Act Boldly.** We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers. * **Deliver Results.** We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we're not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work. * **Succeed Together.** We prioritize Omada's progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together. * **Remember Why We're Here.** We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it. **About Omada Health:** Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA) is reverse engineering the way healthcare is delivered in America, putting the space between doctor visits–where health is won or lost–at the center of care. Today's healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada's virtual\-first model combines human\-led care teams, connected devices, and AI\-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP\-1 therapy. Omada has served more than two million members since launch across 2,000\+ employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and health systems. Learn more at omadahealth.com. Omada is thrilled to share that we've been certified as a Great Place to Work! Please click here for more information. We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. We strive to build an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated and leveraged to inform better design and business decisions. Omada is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. Below is a summary of salary ranges, by geographic zone, for this role\*. These ranges represent a good faith estimate of the minimum and maximum base salary for the position in that zone at the time of posting. Please refer to this resource for detail on zone designations. jobs.title: Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is growing rapidly as one of the world’s major cloud platforms. The expansion of AI, machine learning, and traditional enterprise workloads is creating new demands for cloud infrastructure, from silicon to system software to the boundary where hardware and software meet. The Virtual Networking Data Plane team within OCI builds highly customizable Virtual Cloud Network data plane services on industry\-leading programmable SmartNICs and DPUs. Our work enables predictable performance, secure isolation, and high availability for OCI customers at cloud scale. We are in the middle of a generational transformation in cloud infrastructure, and we are looking for exceptional systems engineering talent to help shape what comes next. This is an exciting opportunity for a hands\-on system software engineer who enjoys building low\-level software close to the hardware. Domain\-specific processors and programmable hardware accelerators are becoming central to modern cloud infrastructure, especially as data centers evolve to support AI\-ready, efficient, and sustainable computing workloads. In this role, you will help develop software for next\-generation programmable DPUs that are foundational to OCI’s networking platform. You will work on performance\-critical systems where Linux internals, hardware\-software co\-design, and high\-performance networking come together. * Architect and implement high performance, highly available system software components – DPDK\-based networking stack, hardware abstraction layers, and custom hardware acceleration stacks. * Leverage C/C\+\+ expertise in building network virtualization, high performance packet processing and protocol parsers. * Leverage Linux OS expertise to manage memory, scheduling, I/O virtualization, kernel drivers and security features of the DPUs. * Collaborate with senior architects and peers across Compute, Storage, OS and Security groups across Oracle, to lead and drive project execution. **Why Join Us** You will be part of a team building the foundation of OCI’s next generation cloud networking platform. The work is technically deep, highly impactful, and central to the future of cloud infrastructure. You will have the opportunity to solve challenging systems problems at scale while helping build infrastructure that supports the next wave of AI, enterprise, and cloud\-native workloads. **Required Qualifications** * Expertise with systems programming in C, C\+\+, Rust, or similar low\-level languages. * Strong understanding of Linux operating system internals. * Experience with networking protocols, packet processing, or high\-performance network programming. * Familiarity with embedded systems, SmartNICs, DPUs, programmable hardware accelerators, or hardware\-adjacent software development. * Ability to debug complex software issues across operating system, driver, firmware, and hardware boundaries. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively in a highly technical engineering environment. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience developing software for SmartNICs, DPUs, NIC drivers, kernel networking, or user\-space packet processing frameworks. * Knowledge of virtualization, cloud networking, SDN, or distributed systems. * Experience with performance tuning, concurrency, memory management, or low\-latency systems. * Background in hardware\-software co\-design or close collaboration with silicon, platform, or firmware teams.

jobs.title: Electrical and Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Title: Electrical and Automation Engineer Location: Mojave, California Near Cities: Santa Clarita, Palmdale, Lancaster, California Job Grade: 21 Pacific Steel Group is a leading independent reinforcing steel fabricator and placer with offices throughout the Western United States. Founded in 2014 by industry veterans, PSG brings the expertise and experience of a large fabricator/installer with unparalleled independence, flexibility, and responsiveness. Today, Pacific Steel Group is one of the largest reinforcing steel fabricators and placers in the United States with more than 1,500 employees. We are recruiting an Electrical and Automation Engineer to support the design, construction, and commissioning of the Mojave Micro Mill, and to transition into a key role supporting plant operations after startup. This greenfield facility integrates advanced automation, robotics, and modern power and energy systems to enable safe, efficient, and low\-emission steel production. The role offers a unique opportunity to contribute from project phase through full\-scale operations, shaping the performance and reliability of a next\-generation steel plant. Job Summary The Electrical and Automation Engineer will support the design, construction, and commissioning of the Mojave Micro Mill and will transition into a key operational role responsible for the performance, reliability, and continuous improvement of all electrical and automation systems across the Meltshop, Rolling Mill, and auxiliary systems. Following plant startup, this role will be accountable for electrical system reliability, automation performance, troubleshooting, and optimization of plant operations, ensuring high equipment availability and process stability. 1\. Steel Plant Design \& Construction Phase * Participate and coordinate the electrical design strategy for the Meltshop, Rolling Mill, and auxiliary systems, ensuring alignment with production and operational objectives. * Collaborate with engineering teams and OEM vendors to develop electrical and automation solutions tailored to our steel manufacturing processes. * Oversee the selection and specification of electrical equipment, including power distribution systems, MCCs, drives, and field instrumentation. * Coordinate integration of Water Treatment, Fume Treatment, and other auxiliary systems. * Support design, installation, and commissioning of the plant electrical substation and power distribution infrastructure. * Support integration of renewable energy systems and interface with plant electrical distribution, ensuring stability and efficiency. * Provide technical oversight during installation, ensuring compliance with local codes, safety requirements, and constructability best practices. 2\. Automation \& Control Systems * Support the design, programming, and commissioning of automation systems including PLCs, HMI/SCADA, drives, and robotic systems. * Collaborate with automation and robotics specialists to integrate autonomous and robotic equipment into steel production processes. * Ensure reliable communication between control systems and field equipment. * Support integration between Level 1 automation (PLC/Drives) and Level 2 systems to ensure proper process control, data flow, and reporting. * Work with industrial communication networks (e.g., Profinet) to ensure robust and secure system architecture. * Contribute to automation strategies that improve safety, reduce manual intervention, and support 'no\-people\-on\-the\-floor' initiatives. 3\. Commissioning \& Startup * Support commissioning activities including system testing, troubleshooting, and performance validation. * Coordinate with OEMs, contractors, and internal teams during startup activities. * Participate in development of commissioning procedures, functional testing, and system acceptance criteria. * Provide hands\-on troubleshooting support during startup to stabilize operations and achieve production targets. 4\. Operations, Reliability \& Continuous Improvement (Post\-Startup) * Own electrical and automation system performance, ensuring high equipment availability and reliability. * Develop and implement preventive and predictive maintenance strategies in collaboration with Maintenance teams. * Lead root cause analysis (RCA) of electrical and automation failures and implement corrective actions. * Support CMMS implementation and ensure accurate asset data, maintenance plans, and failure tracking. * Optimize control systems, process parameters, and automation logic to improve productivity, yield, and process stability. * Support Level 2 systems and integration with MES/ERP platforms for production data and reporting. * Identify and implement continuous improvement and debottlenecking initiatives. * Provide ongoing technical support to Operations during production, including troubleshooting and system optimization. 5\. Power Systems \& Energy Management * Monitor and optimize plant electrical distribution, including load balancing, power quality, and system efficiency. * Support management of power factor, harmonics, and flicker in coordination with utility providers. * Assist in coordination with utility and support integration of renewable energy sources. 6\. Project Management \& Leadership * Support planning and execution of electrical and automation project activities. * Coordinate contractors, technicians, and OEM representatives during installation and commissioning. * Provide technical leadership and guidance to electrical and automation technicians. * Support training and development of operations and maintenance personnel on electrical and automation systems. 7\. Safety \& Compliance * Promote and enforce safety standards and regulatory compliance in all activities. * Ensure compliance with electrical codes and industrial safety standards. * Support safe integration and operation of advanced automation and robotic systems in heavy industrial environments. Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or related field. * 5–10 years of experience preferred (3–7 minimum acceptable) in electrical and automation engineering within heavy industrial environments. * Experience with PLC systems, HMI/SCADA, drives and motion systems, and industrial networks. * Exposure to Level 2 systems, process control, or MES integration is highly desirable. * Familiarity with power distribution systems, MCCs, substations, and field instrumentation. * Understanding of power quality, power factor, and industrial electrical system performance is preferred. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. * Ability to work cross\-functionally with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, and OEM vendors
