jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Frontend
jobs.description: **Description** Staff Software Engineer, Frontend — Authentication \& Identity At realtor.com®, sign\-in is the front door. Every saved home, every saved search, every personalized recommendation and every lead depends on knowing who the consumer is — across web, mobile web and native, and across every subdomain we operate. We are looking for a Staff Engineer to serve as the technical anchor for the frontend of our Authentication \& Identity platform, owning the client\-side architecture that millions of authenticated sessions pass through every day. The Role As a Staff Engineer, you won't just write code; you will define how authentication is built and consumed across every consumer surface at realtor.com®. Auth is the one system every team depends on and no team wants to own — you will own it, and you will make it something other engineers reach for rather than route around. You will balance hands\-on development with high\-level system design, ensuring identity is seamless for consumers and boring for the engineers who integrate with it. Architectural Leadership: Own the end\-to\-end client architecture of our identity platform — our React/Next.js consumer web surfaces, the shared auth libraries every other team consumes, and their integration with Auth0 and our GraphQL gateway. We are actively consolidating multiple co\-existing auth implementations onto one platform; you will lead that convergence and decide what the single path looks like. Auth at Scale, Without Friction: Drive the client\-side work behind new authentication methods — passkeys/WebAuthn, one\-time passcodes, social and federated sign\-in — and own token lifecycle, session continuity and cross\-subdomain identity in the browser. You are responsible for both halves of the tradeoff: reducing forced sign\-outs and abandoned registrations while holding the security line on OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, PKCE and token handling. Reliability and Observability: Auth failures are silent, and users don't file tickets — they leave. You will define what "healthy" means for the sign\-in path, instrument it, and make regressions visible before they show up in conversion. You will lead frontend resiliency and error\-strategy work so that a degraded dependency downgrades the experience instead of ending the session. AI Strategy \& Governance: Lead the integration of AI coding assistants and LLMs into the SDLC. You are responsible for the "human\-in\-the\-loop" verification of AI\-generated code regarding security, performance, and long\-term maintainability — a bar that is higher, not lower, in code that mints and stores credentials. Cross\-Functional Influence: Partner with Product, Security, Data Science and Design, and with the platform teams who consume your libraries. Much of your impact lands through other teams' repositories, which means influence, clear architecture docs and RFCs matter as much as your own commits. About You Technical Mastery: 8\+ years of experience (8\+ in modern stacks) with deep expertise in production React architectures and in browser\-based authentication — OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, PKCE, token storage and refresh, session and cookie semantics, and the failure modes each of them has in the real world. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. Identity Depth: Hands\-on experience with a managed identity provider (Auth0, Okta, Cognito or equivalent) beyond the happy path — migrations between providers or auth systems, custom login flows, bot protection, step\-up verification, and the anonymous\-to\-known user transition. Systems Thinker: You reason about identity as a distributed system, not a login form. Comfortable with cloud\-native design (AWS), micro\-frontend and shared\-library boundaries, versioning and rollout of code that other teams depend on, and building for "the next 10x" of traffic. Operational Excellence: Deep understanding of automated deployment, progressive rollout behind feature flags, and instrumentation. You have run a high\-risk migration on a live, high\-traffic path and know how to ramp it, watch it, and roll it back. Mentorship \& Culture: A natural leader who raises the bar for the entire engineering organization through code reviews, RFCs, and a growth\-oriented mindset — including for the many engineers outside your team who integrate with your platform. Data\-Driven: Professional experience implementing complex A/B testing frameworks and deriving actionable insights from high\-volume traffic data, and the judgment to know when an auth change must not be A/B tested at all. How We Reward You Comprehensive Health: Medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage from day one. Financial Future: 401(k) with 3\.5% match and a unique Student Debt Retirement Savings Match. Balance: Flexible Time Off, 13 Paid Holidays, and 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time. Growth: Tuition reimbursement and 1:1 personalized financial planning.

jobs.title: Senior Controls Engineer, Optical Beam Pointing
jobs.description: At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known. Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us. **About the Team:** The Interplanetary Sciences Program was established to expand access to scientific exploration across our solar system. Its mission is to make planetary research faster, more affordable, and more capable than ever before by rethinking how science missions are designed, built, and operated. The program aims to enable scientists to send instruments to distant worlds without decades of development or prohibitive costs. By creating a sustainable model for interplanetary exploration, we are transforming space science from an occasional event into a continuous process of discovery that accelerates knowledge, broadens participation, and inspires the next generation of explorers. **About the Role:** As a Senior Controls Engineer within the Interplanetary Sciences Program, you will be the technical lead for optical beam pointing and control systems that enable high\-precision optical communications for our 2028 Mars Orbiter mission. You will design, develop, and implement the control algorithms that measure the subsystem orientation using advanced sensor fusion and actively steer both spacecraft attitude and beam orientation to maintain precision optical links across interplanetary distances. This role requires end\-to\-end technical ownership of a mission\-critical control system that integrates optical sensors, gyroscopic measurements, spacecraft attitude control, and fast steering mirror systems. You will develop engineering methods, control architectures, and flight\-ready algorithms that enable the spacecraft to acquire, track, and maintain optical beam pointing while rejecting spacecraft jitter and environmental disturbances. You will work across communications, GNC, flight software, and spacecraft systems teams to ensure the optical beam pointing system meets performance requirements from design through prototyping, ground testing, launch, cruise, and orbital operations at Mars. **What You'll Do:** * Own the design, development, and implementation of optical beam pointing and control algorithms for the 2028 Mars Orbiter mission. * Develop control systems that integrate optical sensor measurements, gyroscopic data, and spacecraft attitude estimates to achieve precision beam pointing and tracking. * Design and implement fast steering mirror control algorithms that reject spacecraft jitter and maintain optical link performance during dynamic conditions. * Develop sensor fusion and state estimation algorithms that combine beacon position measurements with inertial sensing to enable robust pointing control. * Define requirements, interfaces, and verification methods for optical beam pointing performance, including acquisition, tracking, and pointing stability metrics. * Develop and maintain control system models, simulation environments, and analysis tools to predict and verify system performance. * Work with flight software developers to define software requirements, architectures, and interfaces for control algorithm implementation. * Support prototyping and ground testing of optical beam pointing systems, including hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing and system\-level verification. * Serve as technical authority for optical beam pointing and control, working across communications, GNC, spacecraft systems, and flight software teams. * Support flight operations during commissioning and on\-orbit operations, including performance analysis and anomaly resolution. **About You:** * An undergraduate or graduate degree (BS/MS/PhD) in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Control Systems, Physics, or a similar technical discipline with 3\+ years of related experience * Strong background in control systems design and implementation, including classical and modern control theory, state\-space methods, and nonlinear control * Experience with spacecraft guidance, navigation, and control systems for launch vehicles, satellites, or other aerospace applications * Experience developing sensor fusion and state estimation algorithms, including Kalman filtering, observer design, or similar techniques * Strong software development skills in at least one high\-level language (e.g. C\+\+, Rust) and at least one scripting language (e.g. Python, Matlab) * Ability to work in a fast\-paced startup environment with a high degree of autonomy and independence * Ability to complete projects with ownership of end\-to\-end solutions and deliver results on schedule * Ability to work across disciplines and clearly communicate technical decisions, requirements, and tradeoffs to engineering stakeholders **Nice to Have, but not required:** ----------------------------------- * A graduate degree (MS/PhD) in engineering or physics * Prior work in a technical leadership role for spacecraft or satellite development * Experience with image processing algorithms and photon counting detector systems * Experience developing or implementing flight software for real\-time control systems * Experience with fast steering mirror systems, fine pointing mechanisms, or other precision actuation systems * Experience with gyroscopic sensors, IMUs, and inertial measurement processing for spacecraft applications * Familiarity with spacecraft attitude determination and control systems (ADCS) * Experience with modeling and simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink for control system development * Prior work in a startup or agile development environment * Experience supporting spacecraft prototyping, ground testing, integration, or flight operations * Familiarity with deep\-space or interplanetary mission operations * Experience with optical communications, laser pointing and tracking systems, or gimballed RF antenna pointing systems * Experience working with software developers to define requirements and architectures for flight\-critical control systems **We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.** ***If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at*** ***accommodations@relativityspace.com******.*** ***Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission \- via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee \- will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.***

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Reotemp Fab
jobs.description: #### **Job Description:** A highly experienced and driven engineer to lead all engineering functions for the development, specification, and production of thermowells, flushing rings, valves, and miscellaneous fabrication opportunities. This role is responsible for ensuring our product designs align with industry standards (e.g., ASME, ANSI, API), guiding product implementation into manufacturing, and supporting sales with technical expertise. **Company Information:** REOTEMP Instrument Corp is a world class manufacturer of thermometers, pressure gauges, and other temperature and pressure measurement devices. We build a unique type of product that few people have any experience with, so we seek team members who have a passion for learning. The person in this position will engage with dozens of people from accounting to manufacturing on a daily basis and thus should be enthusiastic about working closely with others and ultimately serving our customers. **Key Responsibilities** **Product Development \& Engineering Leadership** * Engineering Manager supports all Fab product lines to ensure thermowells, flushing rings, valves and future products are designed to meet or exceed industry standards (ASME, ANSI, API, etc.). * Review customer specifications and application requirements to provide appropriate design solutions or adaptations. * Develop and maintain a deep understanding of applicable codes, certifications, and external compliance standards, ensuring full regulatory alignment across products. * Serve as a key liaison between design, production, and commercial teams to balance cost, lead time, performance, and compliance. **Manufacturing Integration \& Readiness** * Manage and oversee the Machine Shop including team development. * Implement standard\-compliant designs into manufacturing, working closely with production, machinists, and quality teams to ensure quality, manufacturability, efficiency, and repeatability. * Learn, understand, develop, and implement internal manufacturing processes that comply with applicable industry standards and regulatory requirements (e.g., ISO 9001, IATF 16949, AWS, etc.). * Provide oversight on the development and validation of CNC programs, fixture designs, and welding processes. * Support the internal setup of new manufacturing capabilities, including facility layout planning, equipment specification and installation, and process integration. * Assist in evaluating manufacturing requirements to determine which processes should be procured externally vs. set up internally, based on cost, capacity, complexity, and strategic value. * Assist in coordinating with suppliers and internal teams for tooling, equipment, and material sourcing. * Develop work instructions, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and quality standards. * Support or lead any required process control plan development, and process documentation. **Customer \& Sales Support** * Support sales and customer service teams by providing technical expertise during quoting, product selection, and specification reviews. * Engage with customers, when necessary, to understand technical requirements, resolve product or process\-related issues, and provide timely engineering support that contributes to customer satisfaction and account success. **Compliance, Documentation \& Product Validation** * Ensure all technical documentation, including drawings, data sheets, material specifications, and testing protocols, meets regulatory and customer requirements. * Oversee product validation, including pressure testing, material certification, dimensional inspections, and compliance verification. * Create and maintain Installation, Operation, and Maintenance (IOM) manuals, as well as technical bulletins and product briefs for core products within the Reotemp Fabrication business unit. * Collaborate with quality and compliance teams to ensure production practices support audit readiness and regulatory compliance. **Continuous Improvement \& Team Development** * Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce cost, improve efficiency, and ensure repeatability. * Mentor and guide junior engineers, machinists, and drafters as the team grows. **General Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field (Master’s degree preferred). * 7\+ years of engineering experience in process control components (e.g., thermowells, valves, instrumentation fittings, etc.). * Strong knowledge of relevant industry standards and design codes (e.g., ASME PTC 19\.3 TW, ASME B31\.1/B31\.3, ANSI, API, NACE). * Experience with CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD) and familiarity with engineering documentation control. * Proven track record of bringing engineered products into successful production. * Strong communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical topics to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Collaborative mindset with experience supporting sales, quality, and manufacturing functions. ### **Preferred Skills:** * Experience working with CNC\-machined components and precision manufacturing processes. * Background in pressure\-containing or pressure\-rated components. * Familiarity with product certification processes (e.g., PED, CRN, ISO9001\).

jobs.title: Automation Engineer II
jobs.description: The Automation Engineer II will report to the Automation Engineering Manager and support the development, testing, deployment, and lifecycle maintenance of computerized control systems for KrosFlo large\-scale tangential flow filtration products. This role combines hands\-on controls engineering, structured change management, and cross\-functional execution to deliver reliable automation solutions in a regulated manufacturing environment. The engineer will partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Product Management, Service, and customers. **Responsibilities** * Develop, configure, test, troubleshoot, and maintain PLC, HMI, industrial computer, and SCADA applications used in automated process equipment. * Program and support Rockwell Automation / Allen\-Bradley, Siemens, and AutomationDirect PLC platforms. * Develop and maintain HMI and SCADA applications using Wonderware System Platform. iFix and AutomationDirect C\-more development a plus. * Troubleshoot application scripts, SQL queries, system communications, and control\-system interfaces. * Configure and support industrial networks, including subnets, Network Address Translation, VLANs, and system connectivity. * Integrate and troubleshoot OPC UA/DA, Modbus TCP/RTU, PROFINET, EtherCAT, and DeltaV connectivity. * Troubleshoot electrical controls and instrumentation, including control loops, sinking and sourcing signals, and current\- versus voltage\-based devices. * Apply software version control, documentation control, and formal change\-management practices to released code and system configurations. * Participate in design reviews, risk reviews, FAT, SAT, commissioning, and deployment of custom automated skids. * Write and execute clear test scripts and protocols for software FAT, FAT, SAT, commissioning, and system changes. * Maintain automation standards, reusable templates, test practices, and supporting documentation through controlled change and continuous improvement. * Provide automation expertise to internal teams, customers, and field personnel during design, build, deployment, and troubleshooting. * Develop and deliver basic automation training for Manufacturing Associates, Field Service Technicians, and other internal users. * Define contractor scope, review technical deliverables, track actions, and ensure work meets project, quality, and schedule requirements. * Promote Repligen’s EHS culture by following safe work practices, identifying hazards or near misses, and supporting corrective actions. **Education and/or Work Experience Requirements:** * BS degree in Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Automation Engineering, or a related technical discipline preferred. Relevant process\-control, industrial\-automation, or data\-acquisition experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. * 5\+ years of experience in automation, controls, software, or industrial systems engineering. * Hands\-on experience programming and troubleshooting PLC\-based control systems and HMI/SCADA applications. * Experience with Rockwell Automation / Allen\-Bradley preferred. Experience with Siemens/DeltaV a plus. * Working knowledge of industrial control\-system integration, instrumentation, electrical controls, networks, and communication protocols. * Ability to read and work from electrical schematics, control narratives, P\&IDs, I/O lists, user requirements, and technical specifications. * Experience developing and executing structured functional specifications, software design specifications, test protocols, documenting results, and resolving identified issues. * Working knowledge of software version control, configuration management, and engineering change\-control practices. * Strong technical writing skills with demonstrated attention to Good Documentation Practices. * Experience in cGMP, computer system validation, and GAMP 5 environments preferred. * Programming or scripting experience with Python, VBScript, C/C\+\+, and/or SQL preferred. * Ability to manage priorities, contractor deliverables, and technical actions with ownership and follow\-through. * Strong troubleshooting, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills in a fast\-paced engineering and manufacturing environment. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. * Demonstrated commitment to safety, PPE requirements, safe work practices, and leading by example in alignment with Repligen R\-Values. What Repligen Offers *Our mission is to inspire advances in bioprocessing as a trusted partner in the production of biologic drugs that improve human health worldwide. Focused on cost and process efficiencies, we deliver innovative technologies and solutions that help set new standards in bioprocessing. The estimated salary range for this role, based in the United States of America is $100,000\-$145,000\. Compensation decisions are dependent on several factors including, but not limited to an individual's qualifications, location, internal equity, and alignment with market data. Additionally, employees are eligible to participate in one of our variable cash programs (bonus or commission) and eligible roles may receive equity as part of the compensation package. We offer a wide range of benefits such as paid time off, health/dental/vision, retirement benefits and flexible spending accounts. All compensation and benefits information will be confirmed in writing at the time of offer.*

jobs.title: Associate Principal Electrical Engineer – Interconnection Studies
jobs.description: **Role Summary** ================ Revamp is looking for an Associate Principal Electrical Engineer to lead interconnection and power systems studies for utility\-scale solar and storage projects across the U.S. The studies you produce directly support the addition of renewable energy generation capacity to the north American power grid. As an employee\-owner on our growing team, you will be accountable for your assigned projects, scopes, budgets, and schedules, will serve as one of the discipline's main points of contact for clients and utilities, and mentor junior and mid\-level engineers. Trust here is built through the quality of what you approve, and collaboration with our team of multidisciplinary stakeholders. This role may be performed remotely from almost anywhere in the US or Canada. Salary range advertised above is in USD. In CAD, the range is $CAD 233,000 \- 255,000\. **Duties \& Responsibilities** ============================== **Core Technical \& Functional Responsibilities** ------------------------------------------------- * Lead interconnection projects across ERCOT, PJM, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO, and utility and cooperative systems. * Guide clients from early plant sizing and application submission through scoping meetings, study reviews, mitigation discussions, and compliance closeout. * Review ISO and utility study assumptions and results, identify issues, and direct responses or re\-study requests. * Lead large load interconnection modeling, assumptions, and study sensitivities. * Develop steady\-state and dynamic interconnection models to ISO and utility requirements. * Perform and oversee RMS and EMT studies using PSS®E, PSLF, and PSCAD. * Work with vendor and user\-defined (UDM) inverter models, including model tuning and validation. * Lead grid\-following (GFL) and grid\-forming (GFM) inverter modeling. * Create and oversee the preparation of reports and presentations describing studies performed, solutions developed, and value delivered. * Oversee Temporary Overvoltage, Transient Overvoltage studies for MV collection and substation designs. **Project \& Portfolio Execution** ---------------------------------- * Oversee and guide the technical and delivery performance of a portfolio, or suite, of projects. * Review and finalize scopes, budgets, and schedules for assignments, and identify risks or deviations early. * Collaborating with BD, prepare proposals for professional engineering services for projects and portfolios. * Direct the staff necessary to complete assignments, including staff and mid\-level engineers, and mentor them in technical practice. * Plan, schedule, and coordinate documents and activities across multiple major projects or an entire portfolio. **Quality, Standards \& Compliance** ------------------------------------ * Ensure alignment with applicable FERC Orders governing interconnection processes, relevant NERC reliability standards (including MOD, PRC, and FAC), and IEEE 1547 and IEEE 2800 as implemented by ISOs and utilities. * Prepare and approve model validation and model quality test reports suitable for ISO and utility submittals and audits. * Review interconnection packages, modeling files, and complete project documents for conformity and quality assurance. * Apply sound engineering judgment and standard company procedures to deliver accurate, defensible technical work products. **Collaboration \& Communication** ---------------------------------- * As needed, will act as a supervisor of less experienced staff members. * Act as the discipline's main point of contact for clients, ISOs, and utilities across a portfolio of interconnection projects. * Communicate study impacts, mitigation options, and schedule risk to the developer services and design teams. * Present study results, technical recommendations, and trade\-offs to clients and internal stakeholders. **Program, Strategy \& Innovation** ----------------------------------- * Track interconnection reforms, tariff changes, and modeling requirement updates, and set the team's response to them. * Develop new techniques, tools, or improved processes for interconnection modeling and study production. * Represent Revamp in industry working groups and stakeholder meetings. * Advise upper\-level management and staff as a technical specialist on interconnection matters. **Additional Responsibilities** ------------------------------- * Perform essential duties including meeting deliverables and deadlines. * Perform additional related duties as assigned or directed. **Experience, Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities** =============================================== **Required** ------------ * Bachelor's, Master's or PhD in electrical engineering (Power focus preferred). * 8\+ years of experience performing power system studies with a focus on generator and/or large load interconnection. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience with PSS®E, PSLF, PSCAD, ASPEN and other relevant software. * Strong working knowledge of interconnection processes across multiple ISOs and utilities. * Experience preparing interconnection models and supporting ISO/utility study review cycles. * Strong technical writing skills, including preparation of formal submittals and compliance documentation. * Ability to independently evaluate, select, and adapt modeling procedures and criteria for complex assignments. * Demonstrated ability to lead engineering teams and client relationships across concurrent projects, and to mentor staff. **Preferred** ------------- * Experience supporting utility\-scale renewable generation (solar, storage, hybrid resources). * Prior experience representing owners/developers in ISO study processes. * Participation in ISO stakeholder groups or industry working committees. * Professional Engineer (PE or Canadian P.Eng) license preferred. * Familiar with the components of Large Load models * Experience with TSAT / TARA is desirable **Benefits for Full\-Time Positions** ===================================== * Participation in Revamp's Employee Ownership ESOP program * Competitive compensation with bonus. * Full benefits package including 99% employer\-paid health, vision, life, and dental insurance. * Medical, dependent care, and commuter FSA. * Monthly health and wellness stipend. * Attractive vacation, sick, and holiday pay. * Paid parental leave. * 401(k) savings plan with 100% match up to 6%, vested immediately. * Paid volunteer time off and charitable donation matching. **About Revamp** ================ Founded in 2016, Revamp is the premier employee\-owned engineering design firm dedicated to advancing large\-scale renewable energy projects. Our team is united by a shared commitment to accelerating the global energy transition and creating a workplace where talented people can make a tangible impact in the fight against climate change. As employee\-owners, we take pride in building a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability where every individual's contribution drives both company success and personal growth. Revamp engineers have supported the design of more than 10% of the utility\-scale solar generation capacity in the us since 2020, contributing directly to the renewable energy transformation. So much more than just an engineering firm; we are a diverse, international team of immigrants, singers, dancers, pastry chefs, outdoor enthusiasts, animal lovers, travelers and problem\-solvers who bring curiosity and creativity to everything we do. For more information, visit www.revamp\-eng.com (http://www.revamp\-eng.com) ### **Disclaimers** 1\. Employment with Revamp Engineering Inc. may be subject to background checks that are permitted by applicable law and relevant to the position. Any such checks will be conducted in compliance with all legal requirements, including providing notice, obtaining consent where required, and allowing candidates to access and correct personal information as permitted by law. 2\. Revamp Engineering Inc. is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We value diversity and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Revamp Engineering Inc. is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you require an accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us.

jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the role** ------------------ As our Founding Data Cloud \& Rippling Solutions Sales Manager, you will lead and develop a team of SMB Account Executives for a fast\-paced, high\-growth company. Your leadership will have a direct impact on the growth of the Data Cloud sales team, the training and development of your team, and you’ll be an integral part of Rippling’s growth. This position reports to our Senior Director of IT Sales. **What you will do** -------------------- * Manage, coach and scale a team of Account Executives * Assist your team throughout their strategic sales cycles by deeply understanding customers needs and mapping them to the value of Rippling Data Cloud \& Rippling Solutions * Monitor sales performance: activity, pipelines, monthly forecasts, and closed\-deals to ensure quota attainment * Regularly report on team and individual results through pipeline management and forecasting * Identify and make recommendations for improvement in the areas of process, efficiency and productivity * Lead team to achieve and exceed monthly targets * Participate in hiring and interviewing process, as well as training and ramp\-up of new team members **What you will need** ---------------------- * An experienced sales manager with 3\-5 years manager experience in tech sales * A top performer with a consistent track record of exceeding targets as an individual contributor * Ability to collaborate extensively with Solutions Engineers (SEs), Professional Services, or Forward Deployed Engineers to bridge the gap between "vision" and "execution". * Able to accurately forecast team performance * Motivated with a desire to learn and have a strong work ethic * Ability to thrive in a fast paced environment **Additional Information** -------------------------- Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. The On\-Target Earnings\* US\-based employees will be 50/50 commission split for base/variable pay for the range listed below. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. ### **About the Financial AI Product Team** Rippling’s Financial Product team builds the systems that power some of the most critical financial workflows for modern businesses — including payroll, payments, reconciliation, compliance, and operational finance. These products sit at the intersection of money movement, employee trust, customer operations, and regulatory complexity. The work is high stakes: financial systems must be accurate, reliable, auditable, and resilient, even as they handle messy real\-world data and complex business rules across customers, countries, and use cases. We are using AI to make these workflows dramatically simpler. That means building systems that can interpret inconsistent data, automate manual review, surface exceptions, explain outcomes, and accelerate implementation — while preserving the deterministic controls financial products require. The goal is not AI for its own sake; it is practical, production\-grade AI that helps customers run financial workflows with more speed, confidence, and accuracy. As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you will help define how AI becomes a core part of financial product and infrastructure at Rippling.### **What you will do** * Build AI\-powered product capabilities for complex financial workflows such as onboarding, data ingestion, reconciliation, validation, exception handling, and operational review. * Design systems that combine model\-driven reasoning with deterministic financial execution. * Build workflows that trace financial values back to source evidence, surface unresolved gaps, and prevent downstream execution when validation fails. * Create ingestion and normalization systems that can handle messy exports, historical records, customer\-provided files, and inconsistent provider formats. * Develop evals, testing harnesses, observability, and feedback loops to measure AI quality in workflows where “almost always right” is not good enough. * Partner closely with product, design, operations, compliance, and platform teams to identify high\-impact AI opportunities and turn them into reliable product capabilities. * Work through ambiguous product areas, prototype quickly, and scale successful solutions into reusable product and platform primitives. * Help set the engineering bar for correctness, auditability, security, reliability, and production safety in AI\-enabled and new AI native financial products. ### **What you will need** * Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production systems at meaningful scale. * Experience designing backend systems, data models, APIs, workflows, or platform infrastructure for complex business domains. * Strong judgment around reliability, correctness, edge cases, and operational risk. * Interest in applied AI, LLMs, agents, evals, retrieval, structured extraction, or AI\-assisted workflows. * Ability to reason clearly about where AI should be used, where deterministic systems should take over, and how to build guardrails around model\-driven workflows. * Product sense and comfort operating in ambiguous problem spaces where the right answer is not obvious upfront. * Ability to partner with product managers, domain experts, operations teams, and engineers to turn messy real\-world workflows into simple, scalable software. * A high\-ownership mindset: you can take a problem from vague customer pain through architecture, implementation, rollout, measurement, and iteration. **Additional Information** -------------------------- Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), **Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy,** to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Actual starting pay is based on a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, skillset, qualifications, specific competencies, relevant education, and location. **About Us** ============ Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software\-defined vehicles around the world. The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone. **Role Summary** ================ As RVT's Electronic Control Unit (ECU) portfolio scales across brand partners and expands into triple\-digit country roadmaps — against a backdrop of increasing semiconductor supply chain volatility — sustaining operations have shifted from a downstream function to a core strategic priority. Our Electrical Hardware Technical Program Management team is seeking a Senior Manager to build and lead the ECU sustaining engineering and operations — leveraging both in\-house expertise as well as outsourced debug, design, simulation, test/validation engineering services support to get the job done. This role sits at the intersection of engineering execution and programmatic strategy, requiring deep experience in ECU design as well as process development, coalition\-building and initiative leadership. . In this role, you will own the post\-launch lifecycle of ECU hardware across Zonal, Battery, Infotainment and Connectivity ECUs . This scope includes field return and RMA disposition, failure analysis and root cause, containment and corrective action with our contract manufacturers, engineering change and deviation control, component obsolescence and second\-source qualification, and cost\-down and end\-of\-life transitions. You will be the accountable owner for sustaining issues that reach the plant and/or field, and the person who converts what we learn there into design, test, process, and supplier improvements to integrate into our upstream NPI workflows.. This role also carries direct accountability for the third\-party engineering partners who deliver mechanical engineering and design, component engineering, and reliability test and validation for the ECU portfolio. You will define statements of work, set deliverable and quality expectations, manage capacity and spend, and ensure outsourced scope integrates cleanly with internal execution. The successful candidate brings strong program management instincts, a hands\-on technical foundation in electronics hardware, and the organizational influence to drive complex, multi\-team, multi\-supplier efforts to completion. **Responsibilities** ==================== * Build and lead best\-in\-class ECU sustaining engineering and operations team — failure analysis, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, technical program management, and document control — with domain coverage across Zonal, Battery, Infotainment ,Connectivity, and vehicle access ECUs. * Lead development and implementation of plant/field triage process across brand partners from greenfield state. Define and scale the sustaining operating model as the ECU portfolio grows across vehicle platforms and brand partner programs, including process definition, tooling, and a resource plan that balances internal headcount against outsourced scope. * Own the portfolio of engineering service providers and Contract Manufacture partners that deliver post\-ramp design, validation, qualification, and failure analysis — including the workflows, systems integration, and scalable processes that make sustaining operations repeatable across the ECU portfolio. Define statements of work, deliverables, capacity, and spend, and hold partners accountable to quality and schedule. * Drive for uninterrupted supply from build readiness through mass production: capacity and ramp planning, mitigation of shortages/EOL/single\-source risk, and the design refresh and ECO decisions required to keep products buildable in partnership with Purchasing organizations across brand partners. * Own the RMA and change\-management system with Co ivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site (**https://rivianvw.tech/\#careers**). **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our People Team, Finance, Legal, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies affiliates; and (iii) Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies’ service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services. jobs.title: Senior SOC Engineer - Agentic
jobs.description: **About SANS** Founded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization. Over the next 25 years, it grew to become the most trusted and widely recognized provider of information security training and certification in the world. Today, SANS has served more than 300,000 cybersecurity professionals around the world, with more than 60,000 earning Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) security certifications—the leading certification that provides assurance to employers that their people and prospective hires can do the job. At the heart of SANS is a community of practitioners, from auditors and network administrators to CISOs, who share their lessons learned and collaborate on solutions to the challenges they face. These experts, working across corporations, government agencies, and universities, come together to support and strengthen the global information security community. **Why SANS?** At SANS, our culture is defined by three pillars: Mission, Brand, and People. * Our Mission is to hire people who understand the importance fighting against cybersecurity threats. * Our Brand reflects a commitment to delivering the highest quality training. * Our People are grounded in a culture of fairness, honesty, customer focus, and a pragmatic approach. **What You’ll Achieve at SANS** We are seeking a *Senior SOC Engineer \- Agentic* to join our Security team. This role is a dual\-focus security engineering role. On one side, this engineer owns the design and buildout of our agentic SOC — building the detection engineering, automation, and AI agent infrastructure that allows a lean security team to operate at the scope of a much larger one. On the other, they serve as a hands\-on security engineer across the full breadth of the program: vulnerability management, cloud security, identity and access management, application security, architecture reviews, and compliance support. Initially the role will split roughly evenly between these two tracks. As the Agentic SOC matures and AI agents absorb more of the operational workload, the balance will shift — but the security engineering work never goes away. This is a role for someone who wants to do real security engineering today while building the systems that redefine what security engineering looks like tomorrow. As a *Senior SOC Engineer \- Agentic*, you will: * **Agentic SOC Buildout** + Design the architecture of the agentic SOC. Define how data flows through the detection and response pipeline, how agents are structured and orchestrated, where human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints belong, and how the overall system evolves as we expand agent autonomy. + Build and own detection engineering. Write, tune, and maintain detections across our internal SIEM environment. Treat detection content as code — version\-controlled, peer\-reviewed, tested, measured. Establish the lifecycle of design deploy measure tune improve. + Translate SOC operations into automation. Identify the alert triage, investigation, and response work that is ripe for agent augmentation, and define what good looks like for each workflow before it gets handed to an agent. + Build automations and integrations across our stack. Connect our MSSP, EDR, SIEM, cloud infrastructure, and identity platforms through integrations, scripts, and playbooks — both deterministic automation where that is the right tool, and agent\-driven workflows where it is not. + Partner with AI Engineering to build and govern the agent stack. Co\-design the MCP servers and tool integrations that let agents work with security systems. Contribute to prompt design, evaluation harnesses, and feedback loops — and own the audit trails and checkpoints that keep agent actions safe and accountable. + Operate and improve. Monitor agent performance, investigate failures, tune behavior, and feed real\-world outcomes back into the system. The job does not end when something ships. * **Security Engineering** + Vulnerability management. Own the vulnerability identification, prioritization, and remediation tracking program. Work with engineering and infrastructure teams to drive risk reduction across the environment. + Cloud security. Assess and improve cloud security posture across AWS and Azure — identity and access management (IAM) policy review, configuration hardening, cloud\-native detection, and ongoing posture monitoring. + Identity and access management. Partner with IT and engineering on identity architecture, access reviews, privilege management, and authentication standards. + Application security. Conduct code reviews, threat models, and security assessments for internal applications and integrations. Partner with development teams to shift security left. + Security architecture reviews. Evaluate new technologies, integrations, and infrastructure changes for security risk. Provide pragmatic, risk\-based guidance. + Compliance and audit support. Support security compliance activities, evidenc  live with what you build. If you cannot sit with them and understand the work, you will build the wrong things. * Comfort with ambiguity. This program is being built, not maintained. * Unrestricted authorization to work in the USA; visa sponsorship is not available. Preferred qualifications include: * Experience with MSSP\-managed detection and response environments. * Detection\-as\-code experience: CI/CD pipelines for detection content, automated testing, content packaging. * Prior experience building SOAR playbooks (Tines, Torq, Cortex XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, or equivalent). * Incident response experience beyond Tier 1 — you have owned investigations end to end. * Cloud detection and response experience: audit logging, threat detection services, cloud security posture. * Identity\-focused detection experience (Entra, Okta, Active Directory, or similar). * Any hands\-on experience with LLM tooling: building with LLM APIs, agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.), or MCP servers — even hobby\-level. * Familiarity with agentic development workflows — CLAUDE.md, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot/Codex, or similar AI\-assisted engineering tools. * Prompt injection and LLM adversarial thinking — particularly relevant since security agents constantly read attacker\-controlled data. **Benefits and Perks of Working at SANS** We’re committed to fair and equitable compensation. The expected salary range for this position is **$155,000 to $205,000 which is comprised of base salary and bonus**, depending on geographic location, skills, and experience. At SANS, pay equity and transparency are priorities. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your total well\-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally: * **Financial Benefits**: Competitive base salary, bonus opportunities, and a 401(k) plan with company match. * **Health \& Wellness**: Robust medical, dental, and vision plans; company\-provided short term disability; optional long\-term disability, supplemental life and AD\&D insurance for employees and dependents; voluntary benefits including accident insurance and identity theft protection; fitness and wellness programs; and a company paid employee assistance program (EAP). * **Time Off \& Flexibility**: Generous paid time off, including volunteer time. * **Learning \& Development**: Access to professional development and SANS training opportunities. **Flexibility and Balance at SANS** We support our colleagues with the tools and flexibility they need to thrive, both professionally and personally. As a primarily remote work environment, we are committed to maintaining strong connections, collaboration, and a vibrant culture across virtual teams. While most roles operate remotely, some positions may require occasional in\-person presence depending on role\-specific or business needs. **SANS is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer** SANS is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or any other federal, state, or local protected class. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process, or to perform the essential functions of a position, please contact SANS Human Resources. US Job Seekers: Click here to view the “Know Your Rights” poster. S ANS complies with all applicable state and local laws regarding the consideration of applicants with arrest or conviction records. For positions governed by federal and/or state banking regulations, SANS will adhere to relevant requirements when evaluating candidates with criminal histories. Employment eligibility in the United States is required. SANS does not provide visa sponsorship for this position.

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ **Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.** **Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. This role serves as the primary program management lead for complex customer engagements, driving execution across cross\-functional technical teams while ensuring successful delivery against scope, timeline, budget, and customer objectives. This position is highly customer\-facing and requires deep expertise in technical program management, stakeholder engagement, project governance, and delivery execution. The successful candidate will partner closely with customers, sales, solution architects, engineers, implementation teams, and executive stakeholders to deliver high\-impact AI and infrastructure initiatives. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on direct program leadership, execution excellence, and technical delivery oversight across strategic customer programs. **Role Description** **Technical Program Leadership** * Lead strategic customer\-facing AI, infrastructure, cloud, and technology transformation programs from initial discovery through production deployment. * Develop and maintain comprehensive program plans, roadmaps, delivery schedules, resource plans, and governance frameworks. * Coordinate cross\-functional teams across engineering, architecture, delivery, operations, security, facilities, vendors, and customer organizations. * Drive alignment between technical requirements, business objectives, customer expectations, and delivery milestones. Manage multiple complex workstreams simultaneously while maintaining program\-level visibility and accountability. * **Customer Engagement \& Delivery** * Serve as the primary program management contact for major customer initiatives. * Facilitate executive steering committees, customer business reviews, status meetings, risk reviews, and escalation management. * Build trusted relationships with customer leadership and project stakeholders. * Ensure successful delivery of contracted Statements of Work (SOWs) and achievement of program success criteria. Identify and resolve program risks, issues, dependencies, and resource conflicts before they impact delivery. * **Technical Planning \& Execution** * Lead technical deployment planning for AI infrastructure, cloud, data center, networking, storage, and modernization initiatives. * Translate complex technical requirements into integrated program plans, workstreams, milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria. * Coordinate implementation activities across internal technical teams, external vendors, contractors, and customer resources. * Oversee architecture checkpoints, readiness reviews, testing strategies, deployment planning, cutover activities, and operational transition plans. * Manage technical dependencies across hardware, software, networking, power, cooling, facilities, security, and operational teams. Ensure compliance with project management standards, documentation requirements, and operational best practices. * **Program Controls \& Governance** * Develop executive dashboards, status reports, KPI tracking, and program scorecards. * Monitor program schedules, budgets, resource utilization, milestone completion, and delivery quality. * Facilitate RAID management for risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies. * Manage change requests, scope adjustments, decision logs, and customer communications. jobs.title: Founding Controller, Product & Customer Operations
jobs.description: **About Synthetic** =================== Building a software product has never been easier. But running the business side is still tedious as hell. From contracts, to billing, to getting paid, to keeping the books, Synthetic handles the financial side of a software business from start to finish, so founders can get back to building. The software companies that we're selling to have intense accounting pain. They have a QuickBooks account, a Stripe account, and an unholy menagerie of spreadsheets and agent workflows holding it together. Instead of trying to throw an AI agent at broken software to try to fix it, we rebuilt all the software from the ground up. We rebuilt contracts, accounting, billing, invoicing, and payments. Then we wired up agents that do the busywork in between. The result is a tailor\-made solution for software companies that "just works" out of the box. We can guarantee our customers that the numbers are correct, because we own every system that touches the numbers. And it looks visually stunning. You can read more about us here. We recently raised $10M from investors like Khosla Ventures and Tobi Lütke. We're here to build a company that wins big, which is why we work in\-person in our San Francisco office 6 days a week. But we care about winning, not larping, so we're flexible on hours. **About the Role** ------------------ We'll be launching the product soon. This is our first dedicated accounting hire, and it's a wear\-all\-the\-hats role: part customer service, part AI quality control, part process building, part product research. You report directly to the founder. Our customers trust Synthetic with their money, and our system changes constantly. Your job is to make sure nothing breaks or falls through the cracks for them while we move fast. Sometimes a system is working properly but poorly explained, and you bridge the gap with the customer until we fix it. And sometimes there's a process we haven't automated yet, like customer onboarding today, and you handle it by hand until it makes sense for an engineer to build it. You'll also be building business processes for customer support on the fly. This job will change every quarter. One perk: you'll never do a bank reconciliation. That part is already completely autonomous. **Job Requirements** -------------------- * A CPA. * Controller experience at a software company. You've run real SaaS books. * Fluency in ASC 606, billing, invoicing, and accrual bookkeeping for software businesses. * Clients love you. * You've vibe coded a few things you're happy to show off. **Compensation** ---------------- * $250K – $275K salary * 0\.2% – 0\.3% fully diluted equity * Health benefits * We sponsor visas for exceptional candidates worldwide Compensation Range: $250K \- $275K

jobs.title: Digital Content Manager
jobs.description: SambaNova is a leader in next\-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full\-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi\-turn agents, code generation, and long\-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack\-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state\-of\-the\-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value. SambaNova is a leader in next\-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full\-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi\-turn agents, code generation, and long\-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack\-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state\-of\-the\-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value. **About the Role** ------------------ As a member of the Growth and Digital Marketing team, this role owns the content engine behind our digital channels. Working closely with the product marketing team, you will identify high\-value topics, write most of it, and make sure it attracts attention once it's published. You'll manage the editorial calendar and the content on sambanova.ai, and create the assets demand gen depends on, including landing pages, gated reports, nurture copy, and campaign narratives. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** We're standing up a newly\-funded engineering squad tasked with making ServiceTitan's Exteriors vertical (roofing, siding, windows, gutters) the market\-leading product for that segment. This squad owns the full contractor workflow, spanning both halves of the business: * **Sales**: roofing\-specific personalization, in\-home selling from lead through on\-site presentation, and insurance claim/supplement tracking * **Production**: giving contractors visibility into their project pipeline once a job is sold, from scheduling through completion You'll be building on top of our existing Estimates, SBET, Contract, and e\-sign platforms, with outsized ownership over a product line leadership has explicitly prioritized. This is a rare chance to shape a greenfield product area from the ground up rather than iterate on an established one. **What You'll Do** * Own significant, well\-defined pieces of the full sale\-to\-production lifecycle end to end — from technical design through shipping and iteration. * Design and build full\-stack features across our C\#/.NET backend and React/TypeScript frontend. * Partner closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to translate the needs of roofing, siding, window, and gutter contractors into shipped software. * Make sound technical decisions within your area of ownership, escalating and collaborating with senior engineers and your lead on cross\-cutting or architecturally significant choices. * Write clean, well\-tested, maintainable code, and hold that same bar in code reviews for your teammates. * Debug and resolve complex issues across the stack, including performance and reliability problems in a distributed systems environment. * Contribute to technical design discussions and help evolve the architecture of a fast\-growing product area. * Communicate clearly with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders about progress, tradeoffs, and risks. **What You'll Bring** * Equivalent of 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including building production systems used by real customers. * Strong full\-stack ability, with hands\-on experience in C\#/.NET and React/TypeScript (or comparable strongly\-typed backend and modern frontend frameworks) — comfortable moving across the stack as the work requires. * Solid understanding of SQL databases (Microsoft SQL Server or equivalent) and how to design efficient, reliable data models. * Working knowledge of distributed systems and microservices architecture. * Proficiency with Git, unit testing, debugging, and performance profiling. * Strong communication and technical writing skills — you can explain your reasoning clearly to both engineers and non\-engineers. * Comfort with ambiguity: this is a newly\-formed squad building new product surface area, so priorities and requirements will evolve as we learn from contractors in the field. * A genuine interest in understanding the contractor's workflow (sales and production) well enough to build software that actually solves their problems. * B.S., M.S., or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. **Be Human With Us:** Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us. **Use of AI Technology:** We use technology, including automated and AI\-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. **What We Offer:** When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: * **Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work**: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer\-nominated awards, and more. * **Holistic health and wellness benefits:** Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical. * **Support for Titans at all stages of life:** Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more. At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. For candidates in the United States, the good faith salary ranges estimate for this role is Zone 1: $163,400 USD \- $245,000 USD Applicable for: CA, CT, DC, MD, MA, NJ, NY, VA, and WA Zone 2: $152,600 USD \- $229,000 USD Applicable for: All other US locations. International Compensation for candidates residing outside the United States will vary by location and will be discussed during the hiring process. Actual compensation within a range is determined by factors including relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and performance. In addition to base salary, our total compensation package includes an annual bonus, equity, and a holistic suite of benefits.

jobs.description: At Spoonflower (part of the Shutterfly family of brands) our mission is to empower your vision by helping you discover the perfect design for you and your print on wallpaper, fabric, or home decor. Spoonflower connects independent artists worldwide who create designs with consumers, makers, and interior designers looking for unique designs and products that are right for their projects. Spoonflower (part of Shutterfly) is evolving its eCommerce platform into a modern, service\-oriented architecture supporting a global, made\-to\-order retail environment. We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer III to build and evolve backend platform capabilities that support product data, commerce integrations, and downstream consumer systems. This role is for a strong hands\-on engineer who can independently execute complex technical projects, operate production systems, and partner with other teams to deliver scalable platform capabilities. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily using Node.js and TypeScript. * Develop and support applications running in AWS and Kubernetes\-based environments. * Build integrations between internal platform services and external systems including commerce, search, analytics, and other downstream consumers. * Work with relational databases, DynamoDB, and event\-driven architectures to support product data, catalog, and commerce capabilities. * Execute complex technical projects involving distributed systems, data flows, and service integrations. * Contribute to GraphQL and REST APIs that power internal and customer\-facing experiences. * Diagnose and resolve production issues across cloud infrastructure, applications, databases, and service\-to\-service integrations. * Improve reliability, observability, performance, and operational excellence of platform services. * Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions that support Spoonflower's evolving platform architecture. * Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and technical MEMS\-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high\-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.
